jobs.title: Project Coordinator, ESCO
jobs.description:
**Company And Culture**



Complex is the definitive platform for global youth culture and music lifestyle, seamlessly integrating cutting\-edge content, commerce and live experiences with unparalleled scale. Through innovative content, Complex tells stories of music, streetwear and style, sports, art and beyond. Its content engages in a dynamic conversation with the audience, reflecting and shaping the zeitgeist of convergence culture. A powerful media juggernaut paired with a curated marketplace, Complex is redefining the way fans interact with their favorite brands and artists and reshaping the future of digital culture and commerce.


**Why We're Hiring**



The Project Coordinator will provide cross\-functional support to ESCO’s Brand Management and Business Development teams, helping move new partnerships and licensed products from initial opportunity through development, approval, and launch.



This person will serve as a central liaison among ESCO’s internal Product, Creative, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams—as well as external IP holders, record labels, artist management teams, licensors, agencies, retailers, and other partners.



The Project Coordinator will manage project timelines, partner submissions, product and creative approvals, meeting follow\-ups, asset requests, and key deliverables. The role will also support ESCO’s growing business\-development pipeline through research, presentation development, opportunity tracking, and partner coordination.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. This is an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across licensing, business development, brand management, product development, and go\-to\-market execution within a rapidly growing music and culture collectibles business.



The successful Project Coordinator will bring structure, visibility, and consistent follow\-through to ESCO’s partnership and product\-development processes.



Projects will have clearly defined timelines, owners, deliverables, and next steps. Partner submissions and approvals will be accurately tracked, feedback will reach the right teams, and potential delays will be identified early. The business\-development pipeline will remain organized and current, enabling leadership to make informed decisions and prioritize the strongest opportunities.



Most importantly, this person will help ESCO turn more partnership opportunities into successful products by ensuring seamless coordination from initial conversation through development, approval, and launch.

* Track product concepts, card checklists, artwork, packaging, samples, marketing materials, and other project deliverables.
* Schedule project meetings, prepare agendas, capture decisions, document action items, and follow up with responsible team members.
* Identify missing information, approval delays, and other potential risks before they affect production or launch timing.
* Coordinate handoffs among Business Development, Brand Management, Product, Creative, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal.
* Support the development and maintenance of product calendars, launch trackers, approval logs, and project\-status reports.
* Help ensure that internal teams remain aligned on partner expectations, contractual requirements, product scope, and launch timing.

**Licensing and Partner Approvals**

* Coordinate submissions and approvals for product concepts, artwork, card designs, packaging, copy, photography, promotional materials, retail presentations, and product samples.
* Maintain detailed approval trackers showing submission dates, partner feedback, revision status, deadlines, and final approvals.
* Review submissions for completeness and accuracy before sending them to external partners.
* Consolidate partner feedback and translate it into clear, actionable direction for Product, Creative, and Marketing teams.
* Follow up with partners to keep approvals moving and escalate potential delays when necessary.
* Maintain organized records of approved artwork, assets, legal notices, logos, trademarks, style guides, samples, and approval correspondence.
* Track relevant contractual requirements, including approved product categories, territories, distribution channels, exclusivity, launch windows, talent approvals, and marketing commitments.
* Coordinate the receipt and movement of partner\-supplied materials such as photography, video, reference assets, autographs, relics, logos, and brand guidelines.

* Support the Director of Business Development in identifying and developing new partnerships, licensing opportunities, distribution relationships, brand collaborations, and growth initiatives.

* Assist with pitch decks, presentations, proposals, product concepts, meeting materials, and opportunity summaries.
* Coordinate introductory calls, partner meetings, presentations, follow\-up communications, and next steps.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:

We have quickly become America's fastest\-growing home improvement company—providing roofing solutions to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.



As a Project Coordinator, you'll be the backbone of the operations team at Timeproof USA, ensuring every roofing project runs smoothly from the moment it's sold to the day it's completed. You'll coordinate communication between homeowners, crews, and suppliers while supporting our Project Managers and Sales Representatives to deliver the ultimate roofing experience to our customers!


**What You'll Do**


* **Coordinate** project schedules, material deliveries, and crew assignments to ensure timely
* **Communicate regularly** with customers to provide updates, confirm appointments, and manage expectations.

* **Track project progress**, input data into CRM systems (i.e., Salesforce), and ensure all documentation is current.
* **Support Project Managers** in resolving scheduling conflicts, order issues, or customer concerns.
* **Collaborate with vendors and suppliers** to verify deliveries and manage inventory needs


**What's In It for You**


* **Competitive Salary** depending on experience ($28\-$30 per hour)
* **Full benefits package** — Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k and PTO

Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity \& Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.



If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.



Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Newborn Screening Program Specialist - Clinical Genetics
jobs.description:
**Description**  

Under the general direction of the Program Director at the UCLA Area Service Center (ASC), California Newborn Screening Program (NBS), the **Newborn Screening Program Specialist** performs a range of health reporting, administrative, programmatic, data management, and case follow\-up functions in support of statewide newborn screening activities. Responsibilities include supporting result reporting and case management for birthing providers, facilities, pediatricians, and families; maintaining accurate program data; and preparing routine and ad hoc reports using SIS, internal databases, and BI/PEP reports. Reports may include diagnosed cases, facility performance, workload activity, referrals, verifications, and other program measures. The position also develops facility\-specific reports, educational materials, newsletters, charts, and presentations using Microsoft applications, and other applicable data and reporting tools. The position provides follow\-up for positive, incomplete, inadequate, early, missed, and not\-obtained newborn screening specimens, including specimens for infants born outside of a hospital setting. Additional duties include participating in ASC assigned facility site visits, educational events/meetings, annual quality improvement and education planning/implementation, progress reporting and state improvement projects. The Program Specialist monitors newborn screening performance practices among assigned facilities and/or birthing providers, serves as a liaison to our ASC regional facilities/birthing providers, provides technical consultation when fully emerged into the program, communicates program updates and feedback to ASC facilities, leadership, and CDPH representatives as appropriate. The Program Specialist will also participate in assigned office rotation of weekend on\-call/holiday coverage on a monthly basis once reporting metrics are met.


Salary Range: $33\.81 – 53\.93 Hourly

  

Pay range: $33\.81 \- $53\.93 an hour  

  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Ability to use computer equipment, office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Access etc.) and experience in charting or case management
* Ability to fly/travel to and from GDSP All\-staff State Annual Meetings and stay overnight in a hotel as required
* Ability to work on\-call over weekends and/or holidays on occasion as assigned
* Self\-directed with ability to work independently while collaborating with an interdisciplinary team. Client/customer service focused, ability to effectively interact with pediatricians, clinics, specialty care centers and families.
* Excellent written and oral communication required. Skilled in office automation procedures.

**Preferred:**

* Licensed Certified Genetic Counselor
* Master's degree
* Experience handling/completing referrals to state agencies for pediatric providers and or hospital unit
* Ability to complete data charts in excel or other statistical software
* Capable to lead meetings with presentation with minimal supervision. Comfortable with public speaking
* Prior public health experience or knowledge of maternal child health agencies
* Team leadership experience
* Ability to communicate to and work with clinicians, families and other state agencies for patient care
* Case management/utilization management, health education and/or discharge planning experience a plus. Knowledge of CCS desired. Bi\-lingual/Spanish a plus.

jobs.title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
Folio Clinical Research


Job: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator


Location: Los Angeles, CA (5x a week)


About Folio Clinical Research


Folio Clinical Research is a leading urologic research network treating urologic cancers, urinary stones, Peyronie’s disease, sexual and erectile dysfunction (ED), low testosterone, prostate disorders, urinary incontinence, and more. We partner with leading physician practices to create a cohesive, quality\-oriented clinical culture, facilitating best practice sharing across our platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broad suite of clinical trials, providing significant benefits to both physicians and patients.


Position Overview


The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) works directly under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) to manage all aspects of clinical trial activities. The CRC is essential in facilitating and coordinating daily clinical trial activities, ensuring compliance, quality, and efficiency throughout the trial process. This role involves direct collaboration with the PI, sponsors, and other key stakeholders. The CRC will interact with patients during the recruitment and screening process. The CRC will also facilitate the informed consent process and provide ongoing participant support as needed.


About You:

* Experienced Clinical Research Leader: You have a proven track record in managing clinical research operations, from feasibility assessments to study close\-out.
* Operational Expertise: You have deep experience managing day\-to\-day research site operations, ensuring adherence to protocol and regulatory standards
* Mentorship Skills: You have training experience and can successfully collaborate with Principal Investigators, particularly those with minimal research experience.
* Proactive Problem Solver: You always plan ahead and are proactive about having contingency strategies in place.
* Business Acumen: You execute with a sense of urgency, maintaining a keen focus on both research objectives and business outcomes.
* Commitment to Quality and Timeliness: You manage study timelines without compromising on quality.
* Passion for Innovation: You are dedicated to bringing life\-altering treatments to market, driven by patient outcomes.
* Effective Communicator: You communicate clearly and regularly, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring a smooth study.
* Self\-Driven: You thrive with minimal supervision, taking ownership and responsibility for your deliverables.


Key Responsibilities:

* Regulatory and Institutional Compliance: Support the Principal Investigator and relevant departments to ensure all clinical research activities comply with federal regulations, institutional policies, and sponsor requirements.
* Documentation Management: Maintain secure and accurate storage of all study documents, including consent forms, case report forms, and investigational material records, in compliance with both sponsor and institutional requirements.
* Study Oversight: Support the PI in ensuring the study meets compliance standards, including Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals, health and safety requirements, conflict of interest disclosures, and adherence to financial terms.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Maintain regular and effective communication with Sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and internal team members (e.g., Investigators, Nurses, Medical Assistants) to facilitate study progress.
* Meeting Participation: Engage in Site Qualification Visits (SQVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and other key study meetings as required.
* Problem\-Solving and Adaptation: Identify and anticipate potential obstacles to study timelines or deliverables, offering creative solutions to maintain momentum and study integrity.
* Inventory and Equipment Management: Manage study\-specific inventory, including identification, ordering, calibration, and secure storage of equipment required for the study.


Qualifications:

* Minimum of five years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience.
* Experience with various Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) systems.
* Comprehensive understanding of urology and other associated therapeutic areas, medical terminology, to effectively execute clinical trials.
* Deep knowledge of ICH\-GCP, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to implement these effectively throughout the clinical trial.
* Experience with data management processes, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of data collection, entry, and reporting, in line with Good Clinical Data Management Practices (GCDMP).
* Experience ensuring and prioritizing patient safety and data integrity, embodying a commitment to the ethical conduct of clinical trials.
* Experience maintaining the highest quality standards, while focusing on ongoing process improvements that lead to enhanced clinical trial efficiency and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal communication, both written and verbal. Can easily interface with team members and external stakeholders. Proven ability to develop positive relationships with internal teams, physicians, and external partners.
* Strong attention to detail, and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a dynamic research environment.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, M PowerPoint, etc.) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS, RTSM, etc.)
* Ability to prioritize tasks, effectively manage time, and allocate resources efficiently to meet tight study deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health\-related field.

jobs.description:
**Administrative Coordinator**


**California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP)**  

Housed at Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA)

 **About CCWP**



The California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) is a statewide table of worker centers, labor policy advocates, and unions advancing strategies that build durable worker power across California. Our coalition focuses on structural reforms that strengthen worker organizations, expand collective voice, and protect workers, including immigrant and Black workers, from retaliation and exploitation.California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an Interim Managing Director who understands coalition dynamics, coalition tables, operational systems and finances and can work collaboratively with CCWP leadership team, staff, and partners.

 **Overview**


* Position Type: Full\-time, exempt
* Location: Hybrid, must be California\-based. Periodic travel to Sacramento and other in\-state locations required.
* Travel: Periodic travel to Sacramento and other in\-state locations required.
* Reports To: Policy Campaign Manager

  


**Job Description**

  


We are seeking an Administrative Coordinator to provide essential coordination to a statewide coalition of worker centers, labor partners, and community organizations, in order to operate effectively. This role supports communication and communication protocols, manages event logistics, digital and security documentation, financial reimbursements, and day\-to\-day coordination across coalition partners, to ensure that coalition and campaign activities stay organized, timely, and aligned.

  

The Administrative Coordinator will partner with CCWP leadership and workgroups to lead the following areas:

 **Administrative \& Operational Support**

  

* Manage calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination for coalition leadership and staff.

**Coalition Support**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Strong organizational and communication skills**, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

* **Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion, sound judgment, and professionalism.**

The Administrative Coordinator will:

jobs.title: Advertising Coordinator (LA Times Studios)
jobs.description:
The L.A. Times Studios LLC vision is to be the premier studio for groundbreaking and impactful storytelling, setting high standards for excellence in content creation and production. We push the boundaries of traditional media, exploring new formats and platforms to reach diverse and global audiences. By championing innovative ideas and diverse voices, we aspire to create a more connected world through storytelling and events supported by robust revenue streams from advertising sales, branded content, event production, products and business development.
  
  

Join a team of creative, collaborative and innovative professionals, apply today using the link below.
  
  

The Advertising Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and execution of advertising campaigns for entertainment clients across print, digital, social, and promotional platforms. This role serves as a key operational liaison between sales, clients, creative teams, and internal departments to ensure campaigns are launched accurately, on schedule, and aligned with client objectives. The coordinator manages campaign logistics, monitors performance reporting, and assists with client communications to support revenue generation and strong client relationships.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Coordinate the scheduling, trafficking, and execution of advertising campaigns for entertainment clients across multiple platforms, ensuring campaign assets, deadlines, and specifications are met.
* Serve as a central point of coordination between sales teams, clients, creative services, ad operations, and production teams to ensure campaign deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
* Review insertion orders, campaign details, and creative assets to confirm alignment with campaign objectives, advertising specifications, and internal operational processes.
* Support the development of campaign materials including media schedules, proposal documents, presentations, and performance summaries using tools such as Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Track campaign timelines, deliverables, and internal approvals to ensure campaigns launch as scheduled and client expectations are met.
* Assist with campaign reporting by compiling performance data, delivery metrics, and campaign summaries to support account managers and client communications.
* Monitor campaign pacing and flag delivery issues, discrepancies, or operational concerns to appropriate internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate campaign records, documentation, and client information within internal systems and databases.
* Support client service activities by responding to internal and external requests for campaign information, status updates, and documentation.
* Assist with special projects, promotional initiatives, and entertainment marketing programs that support revenue generation and audience engagement.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications, or business and 2\+ years of experience in advertising coordination, media operations, campaign management, account support OR 3\+ years of experience in advertising coordination, media operations, campaign management, account support,
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Google Sheets, Google Slides, Gmail, and Google Docs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment where priorities and deadlines may shift.
* Work extended hours, including evenings, weekends, or holidays, as business needs require.


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience working in media, entertainment advertising, publishing, or digital advertising environments.
* Familiarity with advertising operations systems, order management systems, or ad\-serving platforms.
* Experience supporting advertising campaigns for film studios, streaming platforms, television networks, or entertainment events.
* Knowledge of digital advertising formats, media planning concepts, and campaign performance metrics.

We actively work to create an inclusive environment where all of our employees can thrive. This Privacy Notice for L.A. jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Build a Career With a Growing South Bay Real Estate Business**

South Bay Smith is looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to work closely with Alex Smith and become an important part of our family\-owned residential real estate sales and property management business.

Our business is built on long\-term relationships, deep local knowledge, thoughtful strategy, integrity, and treating clients like family. The South Bay is our home, not just our market, and as we grow, we're committed to preserving the personal service and genuine relationships that have built our reputation.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants responsibility, not simply a list of tasks to complete. You'll become an organizational backbone of the business \- keeping priorities moving, supporting clients, bringing consistency and follow\-through to a fast\-moving workday, and gradually taking ownership of increasingly important areas of the company.

As our Executive Assistant \& Client Experience Coordinator, you'll also help make sure every client feels informed, cared for, and confidently guided through what comes next.

If you're the person who naturally brings order to a busy environment, remembers the details, follows through, and takes satisfaction in making things easier for both clients and the people around you, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

**Executive Support \& Organization** 

* Manage Alex's calendar, scheduling, priorities, reminders, email organization, and follow\-up. Keep deadlines, commitments, and next steps visible and moving forward.
* Anticipate what needs attention, resolve loose ends, and create structure around a busy workday that moves between clients, properties, negotiations, meetings, and new opportunities.
* Help protect Alex's time so he can focus on clients, relationships, negotiations, pricing strategy, and business development.
* Maintain organized systems and improve recurring processes so important information and commitments don't depend on memory alone.

**Client Experience \& Real Estate Support** 

Provide warm, professional, responsive support to clients throughout the sales and property management experience.

Coordinate appointments, meetings, showings, inspections, vendors, and other real estate activities.

Assist with transaction administration, documentation, signatures, deadlines, and follow\-up.

Help clients understand what comes next and ensure communication is timely and thoughtful.

Help create a calm, organized client experience even when things become complicated or fast\-moving.

Marketing, Client Engagement \& Community

Assist with mailings, community activities, marketing projects, and relationship\-building initiatives.

Create polished, dynamic social media and digital content that reflects the South Bay Smith brand, captures attention, and stops the scroll.

Turn property photos, video, local knowledge, client stories, and ideas into compelling finished content efficiently, using good judgment about where time and effort will have the greatest impact.

Support email marketing, print materials, presentations, and other marketing initiatives.

Bring creative ideas for staying connected with past clients, reaching new clients, and strengthening our presence in the community.

**Who We're Looking For**

* The right person doesn't need to know everything about real estate on day one. What matters most is how you work. You'll be a strong fit if you naturally keep track of details others miss, enjoy bringing order to a busy environment, and take satisfaction in making sure things actually get done.
* Are exceptionally organized, detail\-oriented, reliable, and able to follow through without repeated reminders.
* Think ahead, take initiative, and know when to handle something yourself, when to follow up, and when to bring something to Alex's attention \- while respectfully helping keep priorities on track.
* Are resourceful and self\-directed \- you can take a rough idea or desired outcome, figure out what's needed, and move it toward a polished finished product without step\-by\-step direction.
* Can quickly prioritize competing demands based on deadlines, client impact, and importance while staying calm and organized.
* Communicate early, close the loop, and bring solutions whenever possible \- including facts, options, and a recommendation when Alex's judgment is needed.
* Are an excellent written and verbal communicator who can represent Alex and South Bay Smith warmly and professionally.
* Exercise excellent judgment, discretion, and confidentiality, and stay flexible and solution\-oriented when plans change.
* Are technologically fluent, work efficiently across digital platforms, and adapt quickly to new systems.
* Have strong creative and visual instincts, produce polished and engaging content efficiently, and know how to balance quality with speed.
* Enjoy improving systems, want to learn and earn increasing responsibility, and understand that working in a small business sometimes means stepping outside your usual responsibilities to help with an unexpected task or fill a gap when something needs to get done.
* Local South Bay candidates are strongly preferred. We value someone who knows the area, understands the communities we serve, and feels genuinely connected to the South Bay.

**Experience**

Real estate experience is a plus, but not required. Strong candidates may come from executive or administrative support, business operations, client service, project coordination, marketing/content creation, or another role requiring excellent organization, judgment, and follow\-through.

We're also interested in what else you bring to the table. Maybe you have a great eye for social media and marketing, are exceptionally good at creating systems, are naturally strong with clients, or have another capability that could make a growing small business better.

jobs.title: Property Management & Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**Property Management \& Operations Assistant**

Cross\-Business Administrative Support **Beverly Hills \& Around**

**Job Type**

Full\-time

**Pay**

$60,000 – $80,000 a year (DOE)

**Work Location**

In\-person (Beverly Hills, CA)

**Schedule**

Monday to Friday

**Work Environment**

Mac / iOS ecosystem **Multi\-business office**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an assistant with property management administrative experience to support three businesses run by the same partners:

* Commercial and residential real estate investment, development, and property management.
* Construction defect claims and risk consultancy.
* Pre\-settlement litigation funding.

This is an administrative support position, not an analyst or coordinator role. You won't be making deal or case decisions. Instead, you will be the person keeping daily operations organized across all three companies—handling tenant communications, vendor dispatches, rent rolls, document filing, and general office and executive support. If you have hands\-on experience supporting property management operations and want a role with variety across real estate, consulting, and finance, we'd like to hear from you.

**What You'll Do**

**Property Management Operations \& Real Estate Support**

* Handle day\-to\-day tenant communications, maintenance requests, and vendor follow\-ups.
* Dispatch work orders, track repairs, and keep property maintenance logs current.
* Maintain and update rent rolls, lease files, vendor agreements, and tenant insurance certificates (COIs).
* Support real estate investment deal flow: organize offering materials, compile comps, maintain broker contacts, and track transmittals.
* Format, draft, and organize routine correspondence, counteroffers, and term sheet markups under principal direction.

**Cross\-Business \& General Administrative Support**

* **Construction Defect Support:** Organize incoming case materials, track site inspection logs, assemble exhibits, and keep matter files current.
* **Litigation Funding Support:** Assist with funding intake, gather and organize file documentation, and update CRM records.
* **Executive \& Office Admin:** Coordinate calendars, schedule meetings, monitor inboxes, and prepare meeting materials for the partners.
* **Filing \& Document Organization:** Scan, name, and file documents into SharePoint and cloud drives so everything is easy to find.
* **Spreadsheets \& Tracking:** Build and maintain clean tracking sheets, checklists, and logs in Excel.
* **AI \& Automation:** Use tools like Claude or ChatGPT to speed up drafting, data entry, and routine administrative research.
* **General Office Support:** Handle mail, deliveries, supply orders, and occasional local errands to keep the office running smoothly.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Property Management Admin Experience:** Direct administrative experience handling tenant correspondence, vendor dispatch, rent rolls, lease files, or maintenance logs.
* **Follow\-Through:** You take ownership of your task list, stay organized, and close loops on your own without needing multiple reminders.
* **Software Skills:** Fluent in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint). Comfortable working in a Mac / iOS environment.
* **AI Comfort:** Willing and comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to work faster and cut down on repetitive manual work.
* **Discretion:** You will see sensitive financial, legal, and tenant information daily. Total confidentiality is required.
* **In\-Person Availability:** Able to work on\-site Monday through Friday in our Beverly Hills location.

**Compensation \& Growth**

* **Base Pay:** $60,000 – $80,000 per year, depending on direct property management and administrative experience.
* **Opportunity:** Direct day\-to\-day exposure to how three active businesses run. Compensation can grow as you take on more responsibility.

**To Apply**

Please submit your resume along with a brief note summarizing your property management administrative experience and the primary software tools you use daily.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable working physically in the office 5 days a week?
* Do you own a car?
* Do you live within a 30 minute drive from Beverly Hills?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Help Us Build the Next Version of Our Operations Team**

We are a growing logistics company, and we are looking for people who want to do more than simply perform a job.

We want **critical thinkers, passionate workers, problem solvers, and future leaders** who are excited about helping build a company while it is growing.

Our company is still evolving. That means not every process is perfect, not every problem has already been solved, and not every system has already been built.

**That is the opportunity.**

If you are the type of person who notices inefficiencies and immediately starts thinking about how they could be improved, we want to meet you.

If you enjoy solving problems, creating structure, taking ownership, and making an operation better than you found it, this may be the right environment for you.

You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas, improve workflows, challenge inefficient processes, and help shape how our Operations Department functions as the company grows.

We are not looking for someone who only asks:

**“What do you want me to do?”**

We are looking for someone who also asks:

**“Why are we doing it this way?”**

**“Is there a better way?”**

**“What problem are we trying to solve?”**

and

**“How can I help make this operation stronger?”**

The Logistics Operations Coordinator supports our Operations Leaders with the daily execution of customer freight while helping create the structure necessary for our company to scale.

You will work directly inside the operation: entering shipments, coordinating with carriers and drivers, tracking freight, helping with KPIS, maintaining documentation, communicating internally, and identifying problems before they become larger issues.

But this position is about more than completing transactions.

As you learn the operation, we expect you to **think critically about the work you are doing.**

Where are we losing time?

Where are mistakes happening?

What information is missing?

What could be automated?

What process could be simplified?

What could make communication between Sales and Operations better?

What could allow the company to handle more freight without sacrificing service?

Your ideas matter here.

Our goal is to build a team where employees do not simply work **inside** the operation—they help improve it.

* Reviewing shipment information for missing, incomplete, or conflicting details

jobs.description:
**About WPP Media**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

As an Out\-of\-Home Manager, you will lead strategic OOH planning and buying across traditional and digital formats. * Develop OOH strategies based on client objectives, audiences, markets, locations, and the right mix of traditional and digital formats.

* Manage campaigns through production, installation, posting, proof\-of\-performance, maintenance, and completion.

**Requirements**  

  



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

* Strong knowledge of traditional and digital OOH formats, media owners, market research, location strategy, production, and measurement.
* Experience managing multi\-market plans, RFPs, negotiations, budgets, campaign execution, billing, and reconciliation.
* Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook; familiarity with OOH planning and mapping tools is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, solve problems proactively, and coach junior team members.

Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.



WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are seeking a creative, analytical, and results\-driven **Digital Marketing Manager** to lead and grow our digital marketing efforts across paid advertising, social media, search, email, website, and other digital channels.

This role is ideal for someone who has strong hands\-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns and understands how to use data to determine what is working, what is not, and where we should invest next.

We are looking for someone who is both strategic and willing to execute. You should be comfortable launching campaigns, testing new ideas, analyzing performance, collaborating with other teams, creating and coordinating content, and continuously looking for new ways to grow our brand, audience, leads, and revenue.

* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms is strongly preferred.
* Experience with graphic design, video, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar creative tools is a plus.
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS is helpful but not required.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

You enjoy combining creativity with data. You are comfortable trying new ideas, measuring the results, learning from unsuccessful tests, and scaling the campaigns that work.

jobs.description:
The Services Sales Representative creates, advances, and closes profitable service opportunities across our customer base and target markets. The role turns hardware\-led conversations into complete operational outcomes: identifying customer needs, shaping the right service solution, coordinating technical scoping, and guiding opportunities from discovery through contract handoff.  

The mandate is to grow recurring and project\-based services revenue and increase service attachment to product sales, without sacrificing delivery quality, gross margin, or customer expectations. The right candidate is a disciplined consultative seller who can translate complex drone, autonomy, security, training, compliance, and support capabilities into clear business value. **Responsibilities:** ***Pipeline \& Opportunity Ownership**** Build and maintain a qualified services pipeline through outbound prospecting, account expansion, product\-sales collaboration, marketing leads, referrals, partners, and industry events.
* Identify opportunities to attach services to drone, dock, payload, robotics, software, and ArgusLine trailer sales.
* Qualify on business need, operational readiness, technical fit, budget, authority, timing, and risk.
* Own follow\-up cadence, stakeholder mapping, and progression through defined CRM stages.

 ***Discovery \& Solution Development**** Lead structured discovery into use cases, sites, workflows, performance expectations, compliance constraints, and purchasing process.
* Translate needs into the right service pathway, engaging services leadership or technical specialists when deeper scoping is required.
* Develop statements of work, proposals, estimates, and customer presentations using approved offerings, pricing rules, and templates.
* Manage pricing and negotiation within approved authority, protecting target margin and escalating nonstandard terms or delivery risk.

 ***Cross\-Functional Selling \& Handoff**** Partner with product sales early so the customer gets a deployment\-ready solution rather than a hardware\-only transaction.
* Coordinate technical discovery, site assessments, demonstrations, and pilots with the right subject\-matter experts.
* Complete a documented sales\-to\-delivery handoff covering scope, assumptions, contacts, schedule, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and open risks.
* Stay commercially engaged after kickoff to support customer communication, change orders, renewals, references, and additional service adoption.

 ***CRM, Forecasting \& Discipline**** Keep CRM records complete and current: value, stage, close date, products and services, stakeholders, activities, risks, and next action.
* Submit reliable weekly forecasts, identify pipeline gaps early, and execute corrective prospecting.
* Follow approved contracting, pricing, discount, legal review, data handling, export\-control, and aviation compliance processes.

 ***Services Portfolio***
You will become conversant across our services portfolio and know when to bring in a specialist: implementation and professional services, managed autonomy and remote operations, BVLOS readiness and ComplianceOps, role\-based training, support and care programs, data services including mapping, inspection, thermal and LiDAR, and ArgusLine mobile security trailer services. **Qualifications:** ***Required**** Three or more years of B2B consultative sales, solutions sales, or professional services sales. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
* Experience selling services, managed services, technical support, training, consulting, or complex solutions involving multiple stakeholders.
* Able to run discovery, qualify opportunities, build a business case, develop proposals, and negotiate to close through a structured process, with attention to commercial and scope detail.
* Able to learn technical concepts quickly and explain them to operational and executive audiences.
* Willing to travel for customer meetings, site visits, demonstrations, and industry events.

 ***Preferred**** Experience in commercial drones, autonomous systems, robotics, physical security, public safety, industrial inspection, energy, or aviation.
* Familiarity with drone\-in\-a\-box deployments, remote operations, mapping or inspection workflows, aviation compliance, or technical training.
* Experience selling through product\-sales teams, channel partners, integrators, or public\-sector procurement.
* FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate, or willingness to obtain it within a mutually agreed period after hire.

Custom Construction Management provides professional project management and project coordination services for custom residential construction projects.

We work alongside homeowners, builders, architects, interior designers, consultants, subcontractors, and vendors to help keep projects organized, moving forward, and aligned from pre\-construction through project completion.

Our approach is hands\-on, detail\-oriented, and communication\-driven. We focus on project organization, scheduling, documentation, coordination, and consistent follow\-through to help create a smoother construction experience for our clients and project teams.

**About the Position**

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and proactive **Project Coordinator / Assistant Project Manager** to join our team and support the management of multiple custom residential construction projects.

This position will work closely and side\-by\-side with the Project Manager to coordinate day\-to\-day project activities, maintain schedules and documentation, communicate with subcontractors and vendors, and ensure outstanding items are consistently followed through to completion.

This is a **full\-time, in\-person position**. We believe successful project coordination requires close collaboration, consistent communication, and hands\-on involvement with the project team.

Occasional local travel to project jobsites will be required for meetings, project coordination, documentation, and progress reviews.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist the Project Manager with the day\-to\-day coordination of multiple custom residential construction projects

* Review architectural plans, specifications, selections, and other construction documents for project coordination purposes
* Maintain organized digital project files, records, and correspondence
* Communicate project updates, outstanding items, potential delays, and coordination issues to the Project Manager
* Coordinate between the office and field teams to help resolve scheduling and information gaps
* Occasionally visit local jobsites to attend meetings, document progress, verify project information, and assist with coordination
* Assist with punch\-list coordination and project closeout documentation
* Help identify upcoming project needs and follow through on outstanding action items before they become delays

**This position does not include accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, accounts payable, or accounts receivable responsibilities.**

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent follow\-up skills and the ability to independently keep track of outstanding items
* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Professional and comfortable communicating with clients, subcontractors, vendors, architects, designers, consultants, and project teams
* Comfortable working in a collaborative, hands\-on office environment
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar business applications
* Experience with **Buildertrend strongly preferred**
* Experience with **Bluebeam** or similar construction\-document software is a plus but not required
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for occasional local jobsite visits

Education

A **Bachelor's degree is preferred, but not required**, in one of the following areas:

* Construction Management

Relevant hands\-on construction experience may be considered in place of formal education.

jobs.title: Hybrid - Community Outreach Coordinator - Local only
jobs.description:
**Behavior Technician (BT) / Community Outreach Coordinator Hybrid**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

**Location:** Fremont \& San Jose Region, CA  

**Position Type:** Full\-Time  

**Travel Requirement:** Regular local travel required between Fremont and San Jose (strong preference for candidates willing to drive consistently between both regions)

**Position Overview**
---------------------


Community Autism Services (CAS) is seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Behavior Technician (BT) \& Community Outreach Coordinator to support clinical services and community engagement in the Fremont and San Jose markets.


This hybrid role is designed to directly support client outcomes and regional growth. The individual in this position will divide their time between providing high\-quality ABA therapy services and building meaningful relationships with referral partners, schools, pediatric offices, and community organizations.

  

The ideal candidate is energetic, organized, comfortable initiating conversations, and excited to represent CAS in the community while maintaining excellence in direct clinical care.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
----------------------------------

### **Clinical Responsibilities as needed**

* Provide direct 1:1 ABA therapy in home, school, and/or center\-based settings.
* Implement individualized treatment plans under the supervision of a BCBA.
* Collect accurate session data and complete documentation in a timely manner.
* Participate in supervision, team meetings, and ongoing training.
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory and company standards.
* Support positive, professional relationships with families and caregivers.

### **Community Outreach Responsibilities**

* Conduct in\-person outreach visits to pediatricians, schools, therapy providers, and community agencies.
* Identify and develop new referral partnerships in Fremont and San Jose.
* Schedule and attend meetings with prospective community partners.
* Represent CAS at local events, resource fairs, and workshops.
* Collaborate with Intake, Recruiting, and Marketing teams to align outreach efforts with regional growth goals.
* Maintain accurate documentation of all outreach activities in the designated tracker or CRM.
* Provide weekly updates summarizing outreach efforts, wins, and opportunities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Education, Communications, or related field preferred.
* Active RBT certification preferred (or willingness to obtain within 60 days of hire).
* Experience working with children required; ABA experience preferred.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to manage time across clinical and outreach responsibilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Teams, SharePoint).
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and willingness to travel regularly between Fremont and San Jose.

**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------

* **Pay Range:** $25\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour (based on experience and certification).
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays.
* Paid drive time between client sessions and outreach meetings.
* Mileage reimbursement in accordance with company policy.
* Professional development and BCBA supervision opportunities (where applicable).

**About Community Autism Services**
-----------------------------------


Community Autism Services (CAS), a division of The Stepping Stones Group, provides evidence\-based Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy to children and families across multiple service settings, including center, home, and school environments.


At CAS, we believe in thoughtful, steady growth and clinical excellence. We are committed to transforming the lives of children and families through individualized care, strong clinical leadership, and meaningful community partnerships. Our teams are collaborative, data\-driven, and mission\-focused, working together to expand access to high\-quality behavioral health services in the communities we serve.

  

If you are passionate about making a measurable impact while helping grow services in Fremont and San Jose, we encourage you to apply.

**Ivy Park at Cathedral Hill** is a premier senior living community situated on a beautifully landscaped campus. **With communities across California,** **Colorado,** **Hawaii, and Nevada, opportunities for career growth, relocation, and travel are significant. In addition, eligible team members may enjoy the following benefits:**


* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
* Vacation, Personal Day, Sick Pay, Holidays
* Complimentary Meals
* Bonus Opportunities
* Company Paid Life Insurance
* Team Member Discount Program (LifeMart)
* 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match
* Recognition Programs
* Student Loan Refinancing
* Pet Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Emergency Financial Assistance


**The Marketing Coordinator** is responsible for assisting the Marketing Department in handling all administrative tasks, including organizing events; handling all telephone, walk\-in, and inbound mail inquiries; touring qualifying prospects, and assisting with resident move\-ins as needed.


**Responsibilities:**


* Maintain a thorough knowledge of the property’s product and services to effectively and accurately represent the property to referral sources and prospects.

* **Give community tours as a backup to the Marketing Department**
* Handle all inbound telephone, walk\-in, and mail inquiries including completing the inquiry information card, maintaining the ups list, entering new inquiry information into the marketing database, and follow\-up with all correspondence, as directed.
* Qualify prospects, convert qualified prospects to tours, and convert tours to deposits using the sales process, as needed.
* Organize, plan and manage all marketing events staying within the approved budget. T
* Actively attend and participate in resident, family inquiry, and referral source special events held both inside and away from the community.
* Serve as a liaison for residents and family members new to the community. Ensure that all new residents have a smooth transition to their new home.
* Completely and accurately follow a new move\-in checklist


**Qualifications:**


* Able to be flexible, adapt and respond to change, make decisions in stressful situations, and prioritize tasks and projects.
* Able to process information and apply common sense understanding to follow and carry out written or oral instructions.
* Able to analyze, solve and respond to problems or concerns.
* Able to count and perform moderately complex math problems
* Must be highly motivated and able to work independently
* Able to obtain and maintain valid first aid certification
* Must pass a Criminal Background check and Health Screening tests, including physical and TB Tests.
* For the health and safety of our team members and residents, Oakmont Management Group may require team members to vaccinate, participate in daily screening, surveillance testing, and to wear face coverings and other personal protective equipment (PPE) to prevent the spread of the COVID\-19 or other communicable diseases, per regulatory guidelines.

OMG serves thousands of seniors across communities in California, Nevada, and Hawaii. At OMG, we strive to create an atmosphere of family and community among team members, residents, and resident family members. We know that caring and meaningful relationships are the foundation of a rewarding life, and our team is hand\-selected for their skills, previous experience, and passion for working with the elderly. Our practice is to incorporate joy and laughter alongside our expectations of excellence. Walk into our communities and feel our pride of ownership and commitment to service.


Oakmont Management Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Courtsmith Basketball Industries (CBI)** is a growing apparel company specializing in lifestyle apparel, custom team uniforms, and team gear. We are seeking a motivated and customer\-focused **Account Manager** to join our growing team. The Account Manager will be responsible for managing relationships with existing customers, ensuring exceptional service, coordinating orders, and identifying opportunities to grow accounts and generate additional sales.

Responsibilities

* Manage a portfolio of existing customer accounts and develop strong, long\-term relationships.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, providing responsive and professional customer service.
* Proactively communicate with customers to understand their needs, upcoming programs, and purchasing requirements.
* Identify opportunities to increase account sales through additional products, custom apparel, uniforms, team gear, and company programs.
* Coordinate customer orders from initial inquiry through production, fulfillment, and final delivery.
* Prepare and submit sales order information, and other required documentation accurately and on time.
* Follow up with customers regarding quotes, orders, deposits, balances, production timelines, and deliveries.
* Answer customer questions regarding products, pricing, availability, credit terms, orders, and company programs.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date customer records in the CRM and other company systems.
* Work closely with sales, accounting, production, and operations teams to ensure customer expectations are met.
* Understand and promote Courtsmith Basketball Industries products, services, and company programs.
* Conduct customer meetings, presentations, and product demonstrations when appropriate.
* Visit customers when needed to strengthen relationships, evaluate needs, and promote products and services.
* Participate in periodic meetings and sales calls with Executive Management to discuss account strategies, sales opportunities, and business development initiatives.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and proactively address issues or concerns to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Assist with resolving order, product, pricing, and fulfillment issues in a timely and professional manner.
* Maintain a high level of attention to detail when entering orders, customer information, pricing, and other data into company systems.
* Support overall company sales goals while prioritizing customer retention and long\-term account growth.

Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional education or relevant experience is preferred.
* Minimum of **2 years of customer service, account management, sales, or related experience**, preferably in the apparel, fashion, sporting goods, or team sports industry.
* Experience working with CRM software and customer accounts.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.description:
Company: Siemens EDA


Job Title: Technical Account Manager – Strategic Customer Accounts


Job Reference \#: 522524


Job Location: Santa Clara, CA


Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost\-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.


About the Role: The Technical Account Manager independently owns and drives technical engagement for strategic customer accounts across multiple technology domains. This role operates at a broader portfolio and organizational level, leading cross\-functional programs that expand adoption, defend installed base, and accelerate growth. As a TAM, you are a key technical leader for your accounts—shaping solutions, influencing stakeholders, and mentoring others while delivering strong customer outcomes.


What You’ll Do

* Own technical relationships at the divisional and portfolio level within assigned strategic accounts
* Identify customer business and technical challenges, emerging needs, and growth opportunities
* Lead cross\-functional collaboration across Sales, Technical Sales, and Portfolio Units
* Plan and execute technical programs that drive adoption, expansion, and competitive displacement
* Monitor customer satisfaction and lead corrective actions when issues arise
* Develop and manage opportunity and technical account plans with limited supervision
* Advocate for customer requirements internally at the Regional and Flow Technical Director levels
* Initiate and lead collaborative initiatives with portfolio and factory organization
* Mentor and coach junior TAMs and partner with Account Managers on technical strategy


What You’ll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant EDA or semiconductor industry experience
* Required understanding of overall integrated circuit design flow
* Strong knowledge in Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV)
* Multi\-domain expertise in EDA workflows and design methodologies
* Ability to articulate and integrate value across the full Siemens EDA portfolio
* Strong understanding of competitive landscapes and customer decision drivers
* Demonstrated ability to influence, present, and communicate with senior technical stakeholders
* Proven success leading customer\-facing programs and cross\-functional technical programs
* Willingness to travel (including international) up to 30% to customer sites and internal meetings


Why us?


Working at Siemens Software means flexibility \- Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.


A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!


Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

jobs.title: UCaaS & Critical Communications Sales – SLED Account Manager (Northern California / Bay Area)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

IT Management Corporation (ITMC) is a technology solutions provider specializing in networking, communications, cloud, cybersecurity, and managed services. Since 2009, we've helped organizations modernize their technology environments, with a strong focus on State, Local Government, and Education (SLED) customers.


Learn more at ITMC.net.

 **Job Description**  

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow our core Northern California / Bay Area territory. This is one of our most established markets, and you'll be selling both **101VOICE** and **ITMC** into school districts, municipalities, public agencies, higher education institutions, and healthcare organizations where we already have a strong presence.


This is a high\-touch, full\-portfolio role. You'll represent both the UCaaS and voice solutions side of the business, as well as the VAR side, including network infrastructure and physical security solutions. In\-person customer visits and site work are an important part of the role, so you'll need to be based in the territory and able to meet with customers regularly.


What You Will Sell

* 101VOICE UCaaS, VoIP, and Hosted PBX
* SIP, mobility, and unified communication solutions
* CCaaS and advanced call center solutions
* Network infrastructure and physical security (ITMC / VAR business)
* Secure voice and infrastructure integration
* ARVOS Push\-to\-Talk for critical and field communication across education, transportation, government, and public services


Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute a territory strategy for Northern California / Bay Area
* Identify, qualify, and close both new business and expansion within existing accounts
* Build relationships with IT leaders, administrators, and decision\-makers
* Manage full sales cycle from prospecting through contract execution
* Lead discovery, solution design discussions, and executive presentations
* Maintain accurate CRM pipeline and forecasting
* Navigate RFPs, purchasing cooperatives, and procurement frameworks (CMAS, SPURR, USCTPA)
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and leadership teams
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and regional meetings

  

**Qualifications**  

Qualifications

* 5\+ years of telecom, UCaaS, or cloud communication sales experience
* Proven experience selling into State, Local Government, Education, or Healthcare
* Demonstrated ability to generate and close net\-new business, and to grow existing accounts
* Comfortable managing a complex, consultative sales cycle (30–90\+ days)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding quota
* Able to work in\-territory and conduct in\-person customer visits


Preferred Experience

* SLED experience is a strong plus (not required if telecom/UCaaS background is solid)
* Experience with public sector contracts, cooperatives, or framework agreements
* Knowledge of E\-Rate, CTF, or public funding models
* Familiarity with MEDDICC, Challenger, or similar methodologies
* Existing relationships in the SLED ecosystem

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Join ITMC?

* Growing technology company with a strong reputation in the SLED market.
* Work alongside experienced technology, sales, and engineering professionals.
* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.


All information is kept confidential per EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Bound Tree Medical - San Francisco Bay Area
jobs.description:
For 45 years, Bound Tree Medical has stood beside those who answer the call—first responders who move toward crisis with courage and conviction. Founded by an EMT, our company was built on trust, service, and innovation. Today, we continue that mission by equipping EMS, fire, and law enforcement agencies with the tools they need to save lives.
  
  

This role is more than a sales position—it’s a chance to connect your skills to a legacy of impact. Whether you’ve served in EMS or built your career in sales, you’ll find purpose in every conversation, every solution, and every relationship you build. If you’re ready to do work that matters—alongside a team built on trust, purpose, and respect for those who serve—your next mission starts here.
  
  

What You’ll Do
  
* Build and grow relationships with EMS agencies, fire departments, police departments, and other public safety organizations in your territory.
* Provide product insights, demonstrations, and pricing support that reflect the urgency and precision of the field.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure every customer feels heard, supported, and valued.
* Represent Bound Tree at trade shows, conferences, and industry events—becoming a trusted voice in the community.


What You Bring
  
* Experience in EMS, fire, or pre\-hospital care—or a strong track record in outside B2B sales with a desire to serve a mission\-driven customer base.
* The ability to connect with people who live and breathe public safety.
* A mindset focused on growth, service, and meaningful impact.
* The skill to simplify complex product information and present it clearly to diverse audiences.


Why Bound Tree
  
You’re not just a number at Bound Tree Medical. You’re part of a team that values strategic thinking, innovation, and purpose\-driven work. Our mission is making life easier for first responders so they can make lives better. If you’ve ever wanted your work to mean more—to be more than a transaction, more than a quota—this is your opportunity. Join us in supporting the people who make a difference every day.
  
  

When you join Bound Tree Medical, you’re backed by the strength of a billion\-dollar enterprise committed to innovation, service, and improving patient outcomes. As part of the Sarnova family of companies, Bound Tree Medical benefits from the scale, resources, and reputation of a national healthcare leader. That means you can build your career with confidence, knowing you’re supported by a financially strong, mission\-driven organization that’s here for the long haul.
  
  

Once you apply, you’ll receive the full job description outlining responsibilities, qualifications, and compliance details. We believe in transparency and clarity, and every candidate deserves to understand the full scope of the role.
  
  

Sarnova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We offer a competitive salary, commensurate with experience, along with a comprehensive benefits package, including 401(k) Plan. EEO/M/F/Veterans/Disabled. Our mission is to be the best partner for those who save and improve patients’ lives. Excellence in delivering upon our mission is dependent upon having a diverse team that is empowered to bring their full, authentic self to work each day. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve, and we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity.
  
  

**Expected annual earnings opportunity:** approximately $185,000\+, including base salary and target incentive compensation.

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company :**  

Cogent Communications is a multinational, Tier 1 facilities\-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high speed Internet access, private network services, IPv4 address leasing, optical transport services and data center colocation services. Cogent's facilities\-based, all\-optical IP network backbone provides IP services in over 228 markets globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end\-to\-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. Structured tenure pay increases and an uncapped commissions plan offers you unlimited earnings potential. Cogent offers a full benefits package including; Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO) (20 days per year), Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Family Leave (three weeks per year), 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program.
  
  

**Compensation:**  

**\[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range:** \[$19\.23\- $24\.03 per hour or $40,000 – $50,000 per year].
  
  

**Commission:** Commissions are earned on each sale based on product type:
  
  

50% \-150% of one month’s MRCs (monthly recurring charges)
  
  

1/12 of one\-time NRCs (non\-recurring charges) \&
  
  

1/24 of Burst
  
  

**\[Tenured] Base Salary Pay Range:** \[$19\.23 \- $36\.05 per hour or $40,000 \- $75,000 per year] based on achievement of structured tenure based and performance based pay increases.
  
  

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.
  
  

**Responsibilities :**  

Identify new business opportunities within a prescribed Regional Sales Territory via sourcing and prospecting efforts through a high volume of direct calling and emailing efforts.
  
  

Strategize with your Sales Management team on how to sell into your region’s largest commercial and retail buildings, office parks, and professional campuses.
  
  

Compliment prospecting and selling efforts with fieldwork such as building walks, lobby events, property management relationships, and customer face\-to\-face meetings.
  
  

Learn how to understand a customer’s need and then educate them on the connectivity solutions that Cogent can provide to them via consultative and relationship\-building selling techniques.
  
  

Consistently update your efforts in our Customer Relationship Management system.
  
  

Achieve targeted monthly revenue goals.
  
  

**Qualifications :**  

0\-2\+ years of solid, sales experience.
  
  

Strong oral and written communication skills are a must.
  
  

Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team environment with revenue deadlines.
  
  

Working knowledge of computer applications such as Microsoft Office and software applications.
  
  

**Work Environment :**  

This is an in\-office position five days a week to best support your success, allowing for focused mentorship, training, and personal coaching
  
  

By submitting an application or resume for this position, I understand that is an in\-office position.
  
  

To apply for the Regional Account Manager position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com .
  
  

Cogent Communications is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  

\#LI\-DNI
