jobs.title: Account Manager/Performance Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
**About Us**
============


At MAI (pronounced “my”), we're on a mission to democratize advanced advertising technology. We believe that cutting\-edge marketing tools, once exclusive to large enterprises with massive budgets, should be accessible to everyone. Our platform uses AI agents to automate and optimize performance marketing, empowering small and mid\-sized businesses to scale their ad spend profitably without the need for an agency or endless hours of manual campaign management.


Founded by ad platform veterans from Google and Instacart, we've successfully raised a **$25 million Seed funding round led by Kleiner Perkins** to accelerate our growth. This capital will be used to expand our teams, bringing our vision of intelligent, autonomous marketing to life. Our AI agents have already proven their value, helping clients drive **40% more** sales and managing millions in monthly Google Ads spend. **Our client waitlist is growing by the day**.

**Why Join Now**
================


Building the marketing for intelligent AI agents is uncharted territory—and we’re writing the playbook. As a Account Manager/Performance Marketing Strategist at MAI, you’ll be part of our marketing team, helping shape how we engage and scale with eCommerce brands.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Translate client marketing objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery across multiple advertising channels.
* Manage end\-to\-end campaign operations across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other digital ads platforms, collaborating with AI agents to optimize performance, test strategies, and provide regular performance analyses.
* Execute ad hoc marketing operations such as seasonal campaigns, brand promotions, budget reallocations, and ROI target adjustments etc.
* Monitor account health and AI agent activities to prevent performance disruptions, maintain operational stability, and ensure sustained campaign effectiveness.

**What You’ll Bring**
=====================

*Required:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in digital marketing operations or campaign management.
* Proven track record managing full\-funnel campaigns across major channels (Google, Meta, etc.), spanning upper\-funnel brand awareness, mid\-funnel consideration and engagement, and lower\-funnel conversion and performance marketing.
* Strong understanding of digital advertising concepts, including audience segmentation, bidding strategies, attribution, and optimization workflows.
* Experience using campaign management and analytics tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics or equivalent platforms.
* Excellent organizational and analytical skills, with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* Effective communicator who can collaborate cross\-functionally with product, data science, and engineering teams.

*Preferred:*

* Experience working with AI\-assisted or automated marketing systems.
* Familiarity with campaign automation, feed optimization, or dynamic creative testing.
* Understanding of marketing funnel design, conversion tracking, and performance reporting frameworks.
* Prior experience in managing large\-scale accounts with multi\-market or multi\-product structures.

**Why You’ll Love Working at MAI**
==================================

* Unparalleled Learning: You'll be at the forefront of AI agents in a $1T plus industry working and learning from a stellar team.
* High Impact: As an early member of a lean and powerful team, your work will directly shape our core platform's market fit, our culture, and the success of our customers.
* A Culture of Curiosity: We're a tight\-knit team of passionate builders who value transparency, first\-principles thinking, and a relentless drive to solve hard problems together.
* True Ownership: We believe in empowering our team. You'll have significant autonomy over your work and a clear path for growth as the company scales.

**Compensation and Benefits**
=============================


We're offering a stake in our success and a commitment to your well\-being. Our total compensation package is designed to support you, both professionally and personally:

* Salary: Depending on your years of experience, a base salary range of $170,000 to $195,000\.
* Equity: We want you to feel invested in our mission, which is why we offer meaningful equity.
* Health and Wellness: Our medical, dental and vision coverage is designed to take care of you and your family.
* 401(k): We'll help you build for your future with a competitive 401(k) program.


Compensation Range: $170K \- $195K

jobs.title: National Account Manager - Albertsons
jobs.description:
**What We Do**



C.A. Fortune is a national consumer\-centric integrated commerce agency built to help brands win at retail. We deliver sales strategy, in\-store execution, full\-service marketing, and digital commerce through a single, fully integrated partner. Our capabilities span the full shelf: from getting brands on it, to getting them off it.



We're passionate, energetic, and deeply motivated by one thing: helping brands win over customers and consumers. We bring together sales experts, marketers, e\-commerce specialists, data analysts, and creatives. Different backgrounds, one mission.


**Who We Are**



C.A. Fortune is built on the belief that great people build great brands. We're a national consumer\-centric integrated commerce agency. We show up every day to help brands of all sizes grow, compete, and lead. From emerging challengers to established market leaders, we bring the sales horsepower, marketing firepower, and integrated thinking to move the needle at retail.



The best brands are built by the best people. Come build with us.


**Overview of the Role**


* The National Account Manager \- Albertsons position is responsible for creating and executing national Albertsons sales plan that meets or exceeds established sales quotas and supports company revenue and profit targets. You will play a critical role in building our team and building sales for these key customers. If you love selling and building relationships, this could be the role for you!
* Fully remote but must be local to San Francisco, CA to attend Albertsons HQ meetings as needed.
* Salary range $100,000 \- $105,000 based on experience, qualifications and skills.
* Travel Requirements: Minimal overnight travel required (less than 10%) – i.e. industry trade shows, client national sales meetings, \& or any other events that would be warranted; all other travel is within assigned market (automobile)


**What You'll do at C.A. Fortune**


* Meet regularly with existing customers to understand their evolving business needs and position product solutions to address those needs, provide all maintenance, new item submissions, promotional support, etc.
* Build long\-term, productive, and mutually beneficial relationships with existing and new customers \& clients
* Maintain consistent communication and timely follow\-up with customers and clients and be available and responsive to their real\-time needs.
* Manage national review calendar and work closely with clients to obtain distribution goals and improve distribution in Albertsons Companies divisions.
* Able to complete necessary paperwork and assist clients in completing concise presentations.
* Advise clients on national strategy with Albertsons Companies and execute account specific sales plan that meets or exceeds established sales quotas and supports company revenue and profit targets
* Work effectively/professionally with company's internal departments (Client Development Team, Marketing, Insights, Client Services, Business Support Specialists \& Accounts Receivable), assuring elite management of our clients and customers businesses
* Attend all required national trade shows, market specific sales meetings, client specific sales meetings, or any other necessary functions (established by your supervisor)
* Approach ALL aspects of the role with a winning, "can\-do," positive, progressive, solution\-based mindset


**What You Should Bring to the Table**


* Experience calling on Boise retailer, Albertsons Companies Inc National Team
* Strong knowledge of the consumer products industry (specifically food products)
* Mid/strong level of knowledge of grocery retailers in assigned market
* 4\-year bachelor's degree, and/or similar industry experience
* Proficient with all necessary computer\-based programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)
* Strong knowledge of consumer data


**You Will Stand Out if You Have**


* Experience with Albertsons divisions
* Extensive national account management experience with Albertsons


**Perks**


* PTO and sick days
* 11 paid company holidays per year
* 1 Floating holiday
* 2 paid volunteer days per year
* Bonus eligible
* 3 months fully paid parental leave (regardless of gender)
* Medical, dental, and vision
* Paid company life insurance
* 401k with company match

**Our ideal candidate:** We are seeking candidates deeply committed to our mission: to transform the banking industry from within. We lead by example, collaborate with and invest in change\-makers and build sustainable prosperity in our communities.
  
  

**Who we are:** Beneficial State is one of only a handful of B\-Corp banks in the nation and one of the highest\-rated B\-Corps on the planet. That means that we subscribe to a rigorous evaluation standard that measures our positive impact, not just our profitability. We demonstrate how a bank can combine social equity, environmental sustainability, and business stability to create a better financial system – a system that drives inclusive prosperity to benefit people and the planet. \#BCorp \#WeAreBCorps
  
  

**Join our team:** If you are ready to do challenging and transformative work that will build a brighter future for us all, and you are hungry to bring your passion and energy to the table, we welcome your application.

ABOUT US
  
We practice Beneficial Banking™ by investing in social and environmental impact, prioritizing transparency, and expanding access to equitable financial products, all in pursuit of a banking system that is regenerative for the planet and equitable for all. We bring that same commitment to our people by cultivating a vibrant, inclusive, and purpose\-driven culture where employees are empowered to grow, contribute, and thrive. Together, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the communities where we live and work, creating positive impact through partnership, service, and shared success.
  
  

POSITION OVERVIEW
  
The Treasury \& Client Services Supervisor leads the delivery and performance of the Bank’s treasury management services to support client satisfaction, operational efficiency, and revenue growth. This role is responsible for managing treasury management operations, product implementation, deposits, and ongoing client support in alignment with business objectives.
  
The position provides leadership to treasury management staff and partners closely with relationship management, lending, branch operations, and operations teams to ensure effective coordination across treasury management sales, onboarding, and service delivery. The Manager supports product adoption, consistent execution, and a high quality client experience.
  
The Treasury \& Client Services Supervisor is accountable for operational performance, service quality, and risk management within the treasury management function. This includes monitoring key performance indicators, identifying improvement opportunities, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and audit standards. The role serves as a liaison with senior management regarding treasury management strategy, implementation effectiveness, deposit growth, and ongoing product support.
  
  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES
  
Supervisory \& Operational Management
  
* Supervise and direct Treasury \& Client Services Associates to ensure consistent service delivery and adherence to established processes and procedures.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

**The role**
------------


Watershed is hiring an experienced manager for one of our North American Customer Success teams! The team empowers our customers to measure, report and scale with our sustainability platform at the core. Our North American CS team has grown and we are looking for a leader who cares deeply about developing, coaching, and building a team of early career and experienced CSMs.

* Collaborate with our product teams and be the voice of the customer, providing regular and actionable customer feedback
* Develop and implement processes and tools that help the CS function scale and effectively deliver value for customers
* Be a representative of the CS function, and of the broader Watershed leadership team, within the San Francisco office

**You have:**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a Customer Success or similar role including at least 2 years of management experience
* A background and experience with Customer Success in an Enterprise SaaS space

jobs.title: Finance & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Latent**


Latent is building the clinical agentic engine for enterprise pharmacy—software that enables leading health systems to serve more patients, grow their pharmacy operations, and capture more value compliantly, without adding headcount. We are a fast\-moving team looking for thoughtful, ambitious people who want to help build both the business and the systems behind it.

**The Opportunity**


Latent is hiring a Finance \& Business Operations Manager to own the systems that keep the company running: our books, our billing, our spend, our insurance, and our payroll and expense operations. You will be the person who makes sure money moves accurately, on time, and with the right controls behind it.


This is a hands\-on ownership role, not an oversight role. You will work in QuickBooks, Brex, and Rippling directly, and you will design the policies and processes around them. You will partner closely with our strategic finance function—they build the model and the forecast; you own the operational reality that feeds it.


On any given day, you might reconcile a month\-end account, issue a batch of customer invoices, chase a receivable, review expense reports, renegotiate a software renewal, or work through an insurance renewal with our broker.

**What You’ll Do**

**Accounting and the books**

* Own day\-to\-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including categorization, reconciliations, and chart\-of\-accounts hygiene
* Run or support month\-end close, including accruals, prepaids, and account reconciliations
* Keep financial records accurate, organized, and audit\-ready
* Maintain the chart of accounts, classes, and departments so reporting stays meaningful as we grow
* Coordinate with external accounting, bookkeeping, and tax partners

**Invoicing and accounts receivable**

* Own customer invoicing end to end, including recurring, milestone, and usage\-based billing
* Ensure invoices are accurate, properly coded, and issued on schedule
* Track receivables, follow up on outstanding balances, and manage collections
* Resolve billing questions and discrepancies with customers and internal stakeholders
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success so contract terms flow correctly into billing

**Accounts payable, corporate cards, and spend management**

* Administer Brex: card issuance, spend limits, approval flows, receipt compliance, and reporting
* Review vendor bills for accuracy, proper approval, and correct coding
* Manage payment runs, track payment status, and resolve vendor discrepancies
* Own vendor onboarding, renewals, purchasing workflows, and contract records
* Maintain visibility into software subscriptions and other recurring commitments, and identify savings opportunities
* Evaluate vendors and negotiate commercial terms
* Partner with budget owners to ensure purchases are appropriate, approved, and within budget

**Personnel expense and payroll operations**

* Own employee expense management: policy, submission workflows, review, and reimbursement
* Support payroll processing in Rippling, including off\-cycle runs, and ensure accurate GL mapping into QuickBooks
* Maintain employee records and support onboarding, offboarding, and benefits administration workflows
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions on expenses, reimbursements, and payroll
* Partner with People and leadership so compensation changes flow correctly into payroll and the books
* Handle confidential compensation and employee data with consistently sound judgment

**Insurance and business administration**

* Own company business insurance: renewals, broker relationships, coverage reviews, and certificate\-of\-insurance requests
* Ensure coverage keeps pace with headcount, customer contracts, and our risk profile
* Maintain corporate records, state registrations, and business licenses
* Support customer and partner requests for insurance, tax, and compliance documentation

**Building the operations function**

* Identify manual or inefficient processes and replace them with better systems and controls
* Document financial and operational policies, approval thresholds, and operating procedures
* Help select and implement finance and operations tools as the company grows
* Take ownership of new operational priorities as they arise

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in accounting operations, finance operations, business operations, or startup G\&A
* Hands\-on ownership of QuickBooks Online or a comparable general ledger—not just reviewing someone else’s work
* Direct experience running accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expense workflows
* Familiarity with corporate card and spend platforms (Brex, Ramp, or similar) and HR/payroll systems (Rippling, Gusto, Justworks, or similar)
* Excellent attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy
* Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills, with comfort owning recurring deadlines
* Clear, thoughtful communication with colleagues, vendors, and external partners
* A proactive, low\-ego approach and willingness to take ownership
* Comfort operating in a fast\-changing environment with incomplete information

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working at an early\-stage or rapidly growing technology company
* Experience through a full month\-end close, an audit, or a finance systems migration
* Experience managing business insurance renewals or working directly with brokers
* Exposure to multi\-state payroll and payroll compliance
* Experience with procurement or spend\-management systems
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy operations, or health technology

**What Success Looks Like**


Within your first year, you will have:

* Closed the books accurately on a predictable monthly cadence
* Made invoicing and collections run on schedule, with receivables actively managed
* Given company leaders clear visibility into vendor spend, subscriptions, and card activit

jobs.description:
**About Niantic Spatial**


At Niantic Spatial, we're building the future of physical AI. Powered by a proprietary database of over 30 billion posed images, our groundbreaking mapping technology unlocks a new dimension of interaction and spatial intelligence that helps both humans and machines better understand, represent, navigate, and engage with the real environment.


Our reconstruction technology captures environments with geometric accuracy and extreme detail from any standard camera, and our Visual Positioning System delivers precise positioning almost anywhere in the world. We serve customers across robotics, the public sector, and energy and industrial markets \- building for the 80% of economic activity that takes place beyond our screens.

**About the Role**


We're looking for our founding Sales Development Representative to introduce Niantic Spatial to the organizations shaping the future of spatial computing, autonomy, and AI. Reporting into Marketing, you'll follow up on inbound interest, open meaningful first conversations with prospective customers and partners, and build a qualified pipeline.


This role sits at the intersection of research, communication, and disciplined execution. You'll learn how organizations approach their operational and technical challenges, understand their use cases, and assess where our products can help. Your conversations do double duty: they build pipelines, and they give Product real signals about where we are finding product\-market fit.


You'll work closely with marketing, product, business development, and operations to turn market interest into pipeline, and help build the systems, messaging, and feedback loops that make a growing go\-to\-market team more effective.

**What You'll Do**

* **Build Early\-Stage Pipeline \-** Respond quickly to inbound interest, qualify initial fit, and uncover business and technical priorities. Develop outbound campaigns with Marketing and Business Development, testing audiences, messages, channels, and calls to action, then use the results to sharpen how we approach the market.
* **Create Qualified Conversations \-** Research target accounts across industries such as oil and gas, defense and the public sector, and embodied AI. Build an informed point of view on each prospect's business, technical environment, and potential need for spatial intelligence.
* **Reach Prospects Thoughtfully \-** Run personalized outreach across email, phone, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Lead with a clear reason for reaching out and make every interaction useful, whether or not it produces a meeting.
* **Explain the Opportunity \-** Learn our products and point of view deeply enough to explain them clearly to technical and executive audiences. Connect our capabilities to real customer problems without overstating what the products can do.
* **Surface Product\-Market Fit Signal \-** Ask thoughtful questions about how organizations build, deploy, and operate systems that need to understand the physical world. Recognize promising use cases and route the right context to product, sales, and technical teams so they can test where fit is strongest.
* **Hand Off Cleanly \-** Translate discovery notes into a clear articulation of the customer's need, the proposed solution, initial scope, and next steps. Partner with Business Development on the first proposal and make sure the opportunity moves into the sales process with its context intact.
* **Strengthen the Go\-To\-Market Motion \-** Capture patterns from prospect conversations: recurring pain points, objections, terminology, competitive context, and emerging use cases. Share them with Marketing, Business Development, Product, and Operations. Improve our processes, data quality, and tooling, using automation and AI to remove repetitive work while keeping judgment and personalization at the center of the prospect experience.

**What You'll Bring**

* 1\-2 years in sales development, business development, customer\-facing technology, fundraising, or a similarly communication\-intensive role, or strong curiosity and drive early in your career.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences.
* Comfort starting conversations with people you don't know. You listen carefully, ask strong follow\-up questions, and persist without becoming transactional or scripted.
* Ownership of your own work: you can run a thoughtful follow\-up process, keep accurate records, and stay organized across many accounts and conversations.
* Curiosity about how technology changes the way organizations operate, and the ability to learn a complex product, find the business relevance, and communicate it clearly.
* An appetite for experimentation. You'll test a new message or channel, learn from the result, and make the next iteration better.
* Persistence, sound judgment, and a high standard for preparation and follow\-through.
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.

**Nice to Have**

* An interest in AI, spatial computing, robotics, autonomy, mapping, or other technologies that connect digital systems to the physical world.
* Experience using CRM (we use HubSpot), sales engagement, research, and productivity tools.
* Exposure to oil and gas, defense and the public sector, or embodied AI markets.
* Experience working alongside product teams, or an interest in how early customer conversations shape what gets built.

The expected salary range for this role is $102,000–$114,000 per year. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and more.

This role is based in our San Francisco office, with three days per week in office.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**\*\*About Cargo\*\***

At Cargo, we're redefining how teams execute GTM by making them leaner, faster, and engineer\-driven. Cargo is the infrastructure layer teams use to build, run, and scale their AI\-powered GTM org: agents, workflows, and custom applications that power how a revenue team actually operates.We sell this infrastructure to GTM orgs, but we run our own pipeline on it. That means our own sales motion is a live proof point of the product. AI and automation handle the repetitive, low\-leverage work internally, so our team can focus on the conversations that actually move deals forward. We're a small team building fast, and we eat our own dog food — Cargo's own pipeline runs on Cargo.

\*\*Role summary\*\*

We're hiring our first Sales Development Representative to help build the top of our funnel, working directly with our founders and our Head of Revenue. This isn't a role where you're manually prospecting using ten different tools. Cargo's AI and automation handle lead identification, enrichment, and routing, and Tier 2 and 3 accounts flow through automated multi\-channel sequences. Your job is the part AI can't do: the strategic, high\-value human outreach that breaks through the noise on Tier 1 accounts, the judgment calls on messaging, and the conversations that turn a cold lead into a qualified opportunity. Automation doesn't shrink the role — it raises the ceiling on what one person can produce. You'll work in the system daily, not just execute it: tuning sequences, flagging what's converting and what isn't, and feeding that signal back into the playbook.

This is also an explicit path to Account Executive. Prove you can generate and qualify pipeline that closes, and you'll be first in line to carry your own quota as we scale the sales team.

\*\*What's different about this role\*\*

Human effort where it counts. Cargo handles enrichment, sequencing, and signal monitoring on lower\-tier accounts. You spend your time on high\-value manual outreach — calls, personalized emails, and social touches — where a human actually changes the outcome.

Direct line to leadership. You're not tossing meetings over a wall into a black box. You'll work closely with our co\-founder Max and our Head of Revenue to trade insights on objections, what's resonating, and where deals are getting stuck. That feedback shapes the outbound playbook in real time.

Less admin, more selling. No manual list\-building, no CSV wrangling. Leads arrive pre\-scored and tiered; you decide how to work them.

A real track to AE. This role has a defined growth path. Strong performance means you're building toward carrying your own pipeline and quota, not stuck doing SDR work indefinitely.

\*\*Key responsibilities\*\*

\-Research, identify, and prioritize high\-value leads within our target market, using Cargo and automated workflows to cover more ground than a manual process allows.

\-Own strategic, human\-led outbound — calling, personalized email, and social outreach — on Tier 1 accounts where a tailored approach matters most.

\-Run and tune the AI\-assisted workflows behind Tier 2/3 outreach, and refine them based on what the data shows is and isn't working.

\-Qualify inbound and outbound leads against our ICP before handing off for a deeper sales conversation.

\-Share prospect feedback, objections, and market trends with Max and our Head of Revenue, and jointly refine messaging.

\-Monitor and report on KPIs — meetings booked, lead quality, conversion rates, and outreach effectiveness.

\*\*What are we looking for\*\*

\*Experience \& Skills\*

\-Prior outbound B2B sales experience (SDR/BDR or equivalent), with a track record of booking qualified meetings.

\-Comfortable operating and iterating on AI\-assisted sales tools and automation. You don't need to have built these systems, but you know how to run and tune one.

\-Not afraid to pick up the phone. Calling still works when done right, and you know how to break through the noise.

\-Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

\*Mindset\*

\-High agency. You treat your pipeline like it's your business, not a list of tasks.

\-Curious. You ask sharp questions and dig for insight instead of running the same script on every call.

\-Self\-motivated. You thrive independently and as part of a lean, fast\-moving team.

\-Coachable and ambitious. You want this role to be a launchpad — you're here to prove you can close, not just book meetings.

\-Comfortable with ambiguity. As one of our earliest sales hires, you'll help define the playbook, not just follow one

\*\*How we measure success?\*\*

\-Qualified meetings booked — volume and quality against ICP.

\-Meeting\-to\-opportunity conversion — are the meetings you book actually turning into workable pipeline.

\-Outreach effectiveness — response and conversion rates across your owned sequences and channels.

\-Playbook contribution — the insights and iterations you bring back that make the whole motion sharper.

\*\*Why you should work with us\*\*

\*Standard Benefits\*

\-Travel \& team\-building — annual team offsite and other team\-building events.

\-"We Got Your Back" Budget — covers daycare, new glasses, taxis, whatever helps you work better.

\-Growing You Budget — for courses, tools, coaching, or new skills.

\*Unique Perks\*

\-Equity for everyone — all full\-time employees get a stake in Cargo.

\-Workspace budget — set up your ideal desk.

\-Team dinners \& meetups — on us.

\-A real path to AE — this role is designed to grow into full\-cycle ownership.

\*Cargo is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.\*

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94110

**About PredictHQ**


AI and forecasting systems have a blind spot: the real\-world conditions that shift demand land as surprises instead of signals. PredictHQ closes that gap. We're the real\-world context platform trusted by some of the world's largest enterprises, including Uber, Expedia, and CVS, explaining more than 60 percent of real\-world demand variability so businesses can make high\-stakes decisions on pricing, staffing, and inventory with confidence.

**Our Values**


PredictHQ is about teamwork to achieve huge things. We are building innovative and complex products, so our empathetic, hard\-working culture is key to our success. We are proactive in helping our teammates grow and thrive in their careers, as well as making sure everyone can put their family and friends first.


We’re looking for a driven and strategic Enterprise Outbound Sales Development Representative to join our growing Go\-to\-Market team in San Francisco.


As an Enterprise SDR at PredictHQ, you’ll be on the front lines of our revenue engine, helping drive pipeline and business growth. jobs.description:
**Why Join ADAPT?**


It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill\-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well\-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self\-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.
* Responds to crisis situations and medical emergencies, including providing first aid and contacting emergency personnel as needed.
* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.
* Ensures all actions are conducted in a manner that prevents abuse, neglect, or exploitation, and immediately reports any concerns in accordance with agency policy.
* Follows all OPWDD\-approved behavior management guidelines, including use of approved interventions when required.
* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in\-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person\-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Valid New York State Driver’s License, maintained in good standing
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20\.17/hour (after probation) \+ Industry\-Leading Benefits for all full\-time employees.

**At ADAPT, we value diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.** We strive to ensure that our employees are comfortable bringing their whole, authentic self to work and that the people we support can also be their authentic selves. We value diverse backgrounds, opinions, ideas, and ways of thinking. We aim to build an inclusive and diverse workforce that is empowered and supported with leaders who create diverse and inclusive teams. We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.


ADAPT Community Network is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified candidates of diverse ethnic and racial backgrounds and status are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

This is an active, people\-focused position for someone who genuinely enjoys working around children, teens, families, and teaching artists. The ideal candidate notices what needs attention, takes initiative, and helps the program run smoothly without needing constant direction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Warmly greet students and families as they arrive
* Learn student and family names and help new families navigate the space
* Answer basic questions about class locations, arrival, dismissal, and other on\-site logistics
* Help create and maintain Broadway Rise’s warm, inclusive, and professional culture
* Prepare and reset classrooms and shared program spaces
* Assist teachers with materials and reasonable on\-site needs
* Support student arrival, attendance, transitions, and dismissal
* Keep classrooms, reception areas, and shared spaces organized
* Capture authentic, high\-quality smartphone photos and videos during classes, rehearsals, teaching moments, performances, and behind\-the\-scenes activities
* Follow all privacy and media\-permission requirements when capturing content
* Assist with printing, scanning, organizing materials, preparing paperwork, and other light administrative tasks
* Provide basic on\-site updates to Broadway Rise management
* Flag parent questions, supply needs, or other matters requiring follow\-up
* Assist with light cleanup as needed

**Required Weekly Schedule**

Applicants must be consistently available for all five working shifts:

* Monday: 3:00–6:15 PM
* Tuesday: 2:30–5:45 PM
* Wednesday: 3:00–6:45 PM
* Thursday: 3:00–7:15 PM
* Saturday: 9:30 AM–3:15 PM

There are no regularly scheduled shifts on Friday or Sunday.

Please apply only if you can reliably work the complete weekly schedule. This position is not suitable for candidates seeking rotating or flexible hours.

Hours may vary due to public holidays, scheduled weeks off, and Broadway Rise’s program calendar. Additional paid hours may be available during production and performance weeks.

**Qualifications**

* Naturally warm, outgoing, and comfortable welcoming children, teens, and families
* Reliable, punctual, organized, and attentive to detail
* Comfortable working independently and taking initiative
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills
* Able to remain calm and helpful in a busy performing arts environment
* Confident capturing strong smartphone photos and videos
* Comfortable following privacy and media\-permission guidelines
* Able to collaborate effectively with teachers and Broadway Rise management
* Comfortable with basic administrative tasks, including printing, scanning, email, and Google Workspace
* Prior customer service, reception, education, childcare, arts, or studio experience is helpful but not required
* Interest in theatre, music, dance, education, or the performing arts is a plus

**Compensation and Employment**

* $23 per hour
* Approximately 20\.25 regular hours per week
* Approximately $465 per week gross on the regular schedule
* Temporary part\-time W\-2 employment for Fall 2026

If the position is a strong fit, there may be an opportunity to continue into the Spring season or expand the role based on Broadway Rise’s business and staffing needs. Continued or expanded employment is not guaranteed.

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

* Your résumé
* A brief note explaining why this position interests you
* Confirmation that you are consistently available for every required shift listed above
* A short description of any experience you have working with children, families, customers, or performing arts organizations
* A short description of your comfort level capturing smartphone photos and videos

Broadway Rise is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our students, families, and staff.

Pay: $23\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Are you consistently available for all the scheduled times posted in the job description?
* Are you able to commute reliably to our Upper West Side location at 93rd Street and Broadway for every scheduled shift?
* In 2–4 sentences, what interests you about working with Broadway Rise and supporting a performing arts program?
* Briefly describe your experience in customer service, reception, education, childcare, arts programming, or another public\-facing role.
* Do you enjoy working with children and teens, and are you comfortable interacting warmly and professionally with their families?

Our mission is to inspire and empower all young people to take control of their future.


OUR VISION

The Office \& Operations Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day administrative and operational functions of Roads to Success, Inc. jobs.title: Apparel and Promotional Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
A to Z Media is seeking a detail\-oriented Apparel \& Promotional Product Development Coordinator. In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our merchandise department, executing and tracking product development, logistics, and vendor coordination for a diverse roster of music and brand clients.  

  

This role will focus on the seamless execution of merchandise programs, from initial start to final delivery. This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized individual with a passion for music who thrives on cross\-functional collaboration, precise timeline management, and hands\-on problem solving.  

  

**What You’ll Do**  

  

**Product Development \& Timeline Tracking**  

  

\- Production Tracking \- manage the day\-to\-day product lifecycle, tracking items through the design, proofing, manufacturing, and final delivery stages  

\- Art Trafficking \- work closely with the internal Art Department to route design assets and proofs, ensuring client approvals are secured and accurate  

\- Schedule Maintenance \- maintain an up\-to\-date production calendar and generate weekly status reports to ensure all open projects stay on schedule  

\- Quality Control \- monitor pre\-production samples for quality issues, coordinate client approvals, and flag any discrepancies immediately  

  

**Vendor \& Sourcing Coordination**  

  

\- Vendor Liaison \- serve as a point of contact for our global vendor network to secure pricing, proofs, production timelines, and shipping methods  

\- Order Administration \- issue accurate Purchase Orders (POs) to vendors, confirm receipt, and monitor vendor portals for completion dates  

\- Sourcing Support \- assist in researching and vetting new vendors and manufacturers to expand apparel and promotional product options  

  

**Client Services \& Communication**  

  

\- Account Management \- maintain regular, clear communication (via email, Slack, Zoom, and phone) with clients, managers, and sales teams regarding job statuses  

\- Asset Creation \- assist in compiling internal pitch decks and monthly recaps showcasing newly developed products  

\- Issue Resolution \- act as a responsive point of contact for client claims, following established procedures to correct production or delivery errors swiftly  

  

**Logistics, Data, \& Order Administration**  

  

\- Database Accuracy \- maintain accurate and real\-time records of milestones, production notes, and shipping details within our custom database  

\- Financial Administration \- generate and issue accurate client invoices upon project completion; coordinate VAT and domestic sales tax billing with the finance team  

\- Inventory \& Warehouse Coordination \- liaise with the warehouse team to coordinate incoming shipments, pickups, physical inventory counts, and product reworks  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

\- Experience \- 2 \- 4 years of relevant experience in product coordination, apparel production, account \- management, or merchandise operations  

\- Industry Knowledge \- direct experience working within an apparel, promotional products, or music merchandise environment is highly preferred  

\- Project Management \- proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment  

\- Communication \- exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both business executives and creative artists/managers  

\- Adaptability \- high comfort level working in a dynamic environment, with a "can\-do" attitude and a knack for proactive problem\-solving  

  

**Key Skill Set**  

  

\- Extreme Attention to Detail \- inherent focus on follow\-through, database accuracy, and order precision  

\- Cross\-Functional Collaboration \- ability to act as a seamless bridge between sales, art, logistics, accounting, and external partners.  

\- Logistical Aptitude \- understanding of shipping, tracking, warehousing, and production workflows  

\- Creative Alignment \- a strong eye for product quality and design, combined with a genuine passion for music culture and artist branding.  

  

Founded in 1994, A to Z Media is a family\-owned company specializing in Vinyl, CD, DVD, Promotional Product and Apparel, and Manufacturing Services. For over 30 years, we have been committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high\-quality products, and competitive pricing for our global clientele. We work closely with clients to provide bespoke manufacturing solutions, including special printing, packaging, production, and logistical support. Our clients range from indie labels and branding agencies to distributors and Fortune 500 companies. At A to Z Media, we pride ourselves on being a true partner in bringing creative visions to life.  

  

Full\-Time, Onsite to Hybrid, $45,000 \- $65,000

The Chelsea Piers Field House is looking for a talented individual to join our Events team. **The Event Operations Coordinator** will work in a fast\-paced environment, handling all aspects of event operations and execution — with a heavy focus on our birthday party program, one of the highest\-volume, highest\-visibility parts of our business — plus related administrative tasks.This position reports to the Field House Director of Events and works side by side with our Birthday Party and Special Events sales team to ensure a seamless customer experience from sales to planning to execution. Given the volume of parties run each week, this role requires someone who can juggle multiple events at once without losing precision on any one of them. The Event Operations Coordinator should be an outgoing individual with exemplary customer service skills, highly organized, detail\-oriented, and calm under pressure.

**As the Event Operations Coordinator, you will be expected to:**

* Manage and oversee party and event staff to ensure the SOPs are being followed and a consistent high quality of service is being rendered

* Work closely with other Field House directors to ensure events, parties, and programming run successfully \& safely together

	+ Birthday Parties
	+ Team Building
	+ Bar/Bat Mitzvahs
	+ Adult Birthday Parties/Bachelor Parties
	+ Location Shoots
* Send out feedback surveys to clients after events have concluded
* Share a daily recap, including successes and complaints; make necessary changes to avoid them in the future
* Create accurate customer invoices and charge parties and events according to contracts
* Assist with hiring, training, and supervising Field House Party \& Special Event staff
* Help with Customer Service and overall facility management on a handful of weekend days

* **Part \- Time: Sunday \& Thursday** required; additional days assigned based on event volume. Hours are non\-traditional and fluctuate week to week based on the events calendar

jobs.title: Manager, Field Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**



Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.

#### **The Role**



We are looking for a Manager, Field Marketing to join our Field Marketing \& Advocacy team. This role owns how Addepar shows up at events across the globe — from national industry conferences and trade shows to our annual user conference, executive summits, and regional community programs. You will support the strategy, lead the team, and ensure every program Addepar runs delivers measurable brand and business impact.



You will manage a team of three: two Field Marketing Managers focused on industry events and regional activations, and a Strategic Events Program Manager who owns our client event programs. Your job is to ensure the team is aligned, the portfolio is coherent, and that every event has a clear strategic purpose and is executed at the highest level.



You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, content, and event experience. You will partner closely with GTM, Product Marketing, R\&D and executive leadership to ensure events drive awareness, deepen client relationships, accelerate pipeline, and reinforce Addepar's position as a market leader.



Addepar takes a market\-based approach to pay. A successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on the role, job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base salary for roles in Colorado, California, and New York.



The current range for this role is $106,000 \- $165,000 (base salary) \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits.



Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.



Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment\-based visas such as H\-1B, F\-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.


#### **What You'll Do**


**Team Leadership \& Development**


* Lead, coach, and develop a team of three field marketers — setting clear goals, maintaining high standards, and creating an environment where the team does their best work
* Help establish \& reinforce roles, responsibilities, and success metrics for each team member, ensuring accountability against event targets, deadlines, and quality standards


**Global Events Strategy \+ Annual Conference Management**


* Manage Addepar's global events portfolio — providing your expert opinion on which events and programs to invest in, how to allocate team and budget resources, and how the full calendar connects to GTM priorities and business outcomes
* Align the events calendar to territory priorities, pipeline goals, product launches, and campaigns
* Own the end\-to\-end execution of our annual user conference, AddeConf, including agenda setting, content creation, event design, logistical oversight and pre\- and post\-event activation
* Continuously evaluate the events portfolio — cutting what's underperforming, doubling down on what works, and identifying new opportunities as the business grows globally


**Cross\-functional Alignment \& Stakeholder Management**


* Serve as the point of contact across the organization for all things events
* Drive alignment across internal stakeholders before, during, and after each program: ensuring Sales knows their role, Product Marketing's messaging is reflected, and AM teams are briefed on their accounts


**Performance Measurement \& Reporting**


* Own the events analytics function — building and maintaining a performance dashboard that tracks KPIs across all programs: leads generated, pipeline influenced, meetings held, cost per lead, NPS, and ROI
* Drive a culture of data\-informed decision\-making within the team, using post\-event insights to continually improve strategy and execution


**Budget \& Operations**


* Manage the full Field Marketing events budget — including allocation across programs, spend tracking, and accountability for ROI
* Ensure the team maintains operational excellence across procurement, vendor contracts, invoicing, compliance submissions, and lead capture processes
* Travel to key events domestically and occasionally internationally to support the team and maintain visibility with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders

#### **Who You Are**


* 6\+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or a closely related B2B marketing discipline — with 2\+ years managing a team
* Proven experience owning a broad events portfolio: from large\-scale flagship conferences to executive programs and regional activations
* Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across complex, cross\-functional organizations
* Proven track record of building \& managing event budgets and reporting performance against pipeline and ROI metrics
* Background in fintech, wealth management, financial services, or enterprise SaaS strongly preferred
* Knowledge of SFDC, Marketo and On24 preferred

**Our Values**


* **Act Like an Owner \-** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Ow

jobs.title: Education Content Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Magma Math**


Magma is one of the world’s fastest\-growing and most celebrated edtech companies, transforming math education. Our platform turns handwritten solutions into digital insights, empowering teachers to focus on creativity and deeper learning — while giving them real\-time visibility into student progress.


The result? More inclusive, engaging, and effective math classrooms for all learners.


But we’re not just building better tools. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in global education: math underperformance. With 1 in 5 students globally struggling in math — a subject that forms the backbone of so many career paths — we believe the opportunity to improve outcomes at scale is massive.


We’re already the go\-to solution in thousands of schools — and we’re just getting started. As we expand rapidly across the U.S. and Europe, we’re building a team as ambitious as our mission: to help millions of students unlock their full potential in math.

### **The role**


We're looking for a writer who already knows K–12 education from the inside, and who wants to spend their day diving into good math instruction.


Maybe you taught math and kept a blog nobody asked you to write. Maybe you coached teachers, built curriculum, sat in a central office, or spent years in edtech close enough to real schools that you still know what goes wrong in a Tier 2 block. However you got here, you'll be writing multiple pieces a week for the people who decide what happens in a district's math classrooms.

### **What you'll write**

* Blog posts and articles. The core of the job. The audience can be a math coach interested in a specific problem of practice: why students who can compute still can't explain, what to do when your intervention block isn't moving the needle, how to run a "same but different" routine with real student work. The audience can also be district leadership keeping up with the trends of screen time in the classroom, safe AI implementation, and more.
* One\-pagers. Tight, genuinely useful documents our team hands to districts. An implementation timeline. What the first three weeks of teacher adoption actually look like. How our approach differs from answer\-checking platforms.
* Campaign copy support. Emails and social posts, often built from something you already wrote.
* Additional assets as needed. Conference materials, a case study, a PD handout, talking points for our sales team, a landing page rewrite. Over time there's room to host webinars, join podcasts, and take on longer research reports that pull results from several districts into one evidence piece.

### **What we're looking for**

* Real K–12 experience, from any direction. Teaching or instructional coaching. Curriculum writing or instructional design. A district or state role in teaching and learning, assessment, or intervention. An edtech career spent close to schools, in implementation, professional learning, customer success, product, or content. Math backgrounds have a head start, and we're glad to talk with strong candidates from other subjects.
* Writing you can show us. Blog posts, a newsletter, curriculum documents, PD materials, a Substack, a conference deck, a program evaluation. It doesn't need to be marketing writing. We're looking for writing where you made an argument and someone read it.
* A comfortable working pace. Two to three finished pieces a week, sustainably, with an editor in your corner.
* Range across registers. A piece for a math coordinator and a piece for a superintendent can make the same argument and share almost no sentences. If you've briefed a board, presented to a cabinet, or worked with proficiency and adoption data, tell us about it.
* Fluency with the language of the work. Productive struggle, vertical alignment, fidelity, discourse, number sense, as things you've watched succeed or fall apart in real life.

#### **What we offer**

* Play a key role in an exciting journey. We are a young company with ambitious targets and meaningful goals
* Fantastic colleagues in a fun environment with great opportunities to learn
* Competitive remuneration \& benefit package
* Annual company trip
* An opportunity to work on a meaningful mission and have an exceptional impact on education, society and how children learn math across the world  

‍

**Start**: As soon as possible

**Salary**: The salary range for this full\-time role is $85k\-$100k per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skill level, and location.

**Office location**: NYC

**Note:** We practice a 4\-day in office policy, and we look forward to working together closely with you.


\#LI\-MAGMA

jobs.description:
Cadogan Tate is a global leader in fine art logistics, trusted by collectors, designers, galleries, and


auction houses around the world. For over four decades, we have provided end\-to\-end logistics


solutions — from secure transport and installation to storage and global shipping — all executed with


discretion, precision, and craftsmanship.

  

As a key client partner, you will oversee logistics from initial consultation through project


completion, ensuring that every interaction reflects Cadogan Tate’s world\-class service. You’ll serve


as both a relationship builder and project leader — balancing operational excellence, commercial


awareness, and client satisfaction. This role is ideal for a strategic, client\-focused professional who


thrives in a fast\-paced environment managing high\-value, complex projects.

 **Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 5\+ years of account management experience within fine art logistics, auction, design, or luxury services.
* Proven record of managing complex, high\-value client portfolios.
* In\-depth understanding of logistics operations, import/export compliance, and project costing.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Moveware or The Studio advantageous (training will be provided).

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, fostering long\-term relationships built on trust, communication, and performance.
* Understand each client’s business goals, aesthetic preferences, and operational needs to deliver tailored logistics solutions.
* Anticipate client needs and proactively resolve issues to ensure seamless service delivery and satisfaction.
* Represent Cadogan Tate at client meetings, site visits, industry events, and networking functions to strengthen relationships and identify new opportunities.

 **Project \& Operations Leadership**

* Lead the end\-to\-end management of domestic and international shipments — from proposal through completion — ensuring adherence to agreed budgets, timelines, and service levels.
* Coordinate with internal teams (dispatch, operations, art handling, crating, storage, credit control, finance) to ensure all project components run smoothly.
* Maintain clear communication with vendors and external partners to manage expectations, schedules, and logistics requirements.
* Supervise the documentation process, including bills of lading, inventories, and insurance requirements.
* Oversee the packing, transport, and installation process, ensuring the utmost care for valuable and irreplaceable objects.

 **Compliance \& Documentation**

* Prepare and manage all necessary customs and compliance documentation, including CITES, NOAA, and U.S. Fish \& Wildlife permits.
* Stay current on changes to international shipping regulations and advise clients accordingly.
* Ensure all inventories, commercial invoices, and documentation align with legal and client\-specific requirements.

 **Financial Management \& Reporting**

* Develop and issue accurate quotations and invoices, ensuring profitability targets are met.
* Track project costs and margins throughout the lifecycle, making proactive adjustments to maintain efficiency.
* Support senior management in achieving department and individual billing and revenue goals (monthly individual target: $80,000\).
* Prepare client and project performance reports as requested.

 **Collaboration \& Team Support**

* Partner with VP’s of Client Services, General Manager, and Directors on large or complex client accounts.
* Mentor and support junior staff, sharing best practices and helping develop their technical and client service skills.
* Work collaboratively with the wider Cadogan Tate network (national and international) to ensure consistency and excellence across service lines.

 **Business Development**

* Identify and pursue opportunities to expand existing client accounts and win new business.
* Contribute to marketing and client engagement initiatives targeting growth sectors within the U.S. and abroad.
* Provide input on pricing, service offerings, and operational strategies to enhance market competitiveness.

 **Quality Assurance \& Continuous Improvement**

* Uphold Cadogan Tate’s brand values and service standards in every interaction.
* Monitor client feedback and implement service improvements where needed.
* Participate in internal reviews and post\-project debriefs to share insights and improve efficiency.

 **General**

* Ensure compliance with all HR policies and procedures, and all other Company policies and procedures in place
* Adhere to all Health \& Safety policies and procedures
* To act at all times in the best interests of Cadogan Tate, its customers and its employees

* Employees have a responsibility to report any concerns to their supervising manager or to Head Office.

* The responsibilities listed in this job specification should be regarded as a guide and not comprehensive list of all the daily requirements of your job. Annual Salary Starting at $70K.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital advertising solutions with the goal of helping consumers find and discover products and services. We help advertisers reach global audiences via Amazon owned and operated sites (Amazon.com, IMDb.com), millions of Fire TVs, Kindles, and Fire Tablets, and on high\-quality sites across the internet via the Amazon DSP. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, our advertising solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and solidify brand loyalty. If you are interested in joining a world\-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  

  

Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions. Amazon Adapt deploys highly skilled, hyper\-agile talent that ensures customers can continue to invest in their partnerships with Amazon Advertising, uninterrupted. The program ensures that the high bar for customer service, strategic partnership, and revenue attainment is maintained during these coverage gaps.

This enables Adapt team members to experience high\-velocity exposure to teams across the organization and to clients across different verticals. The Adapt team prioritizes flexibility, and hires for both 40 and 30 hour work weeks.

You will independently own all client relationships, revenue targets, and product selling. For endemic accounts, you will manage the full product suite across SPB, Display, and Video. For non\-endemic accounts, you will manage DSP renewals, audience strategy, and multi\-tactic adoption across Performance\+, Brand\+, and 3P Deals. * Maintain zero dark periods greater than 60 days

* This is a client\-facing role and requires up to 20% domestic travel as needed

  

A day in the life  

As a Full Funnel Seller on the Adapt team, you start your day with a pipeline review in Salesforce, checking renewal timelines, campaign pacing, and upcoming pitch deadlines across your accounts. You then lead a client call to discuss campaign performance, present optimization recommendations, and advance a Video pitch (endemic) or DSP audience refresh (non\-endemic). Mid\-morning, you prepare a sprint pitch using playbook templates for an upcoming quarterly presentation. After lunch, you conduct a campaign optimization review, identify upsell opportunities, and draft a proposal. You close out the day updating Salesforce, managing stakeholder follow\-ups, and planning tomorrow's client meetings. You own the entire commercial relationship for your accounts.

The Amazon Adapt team specializes in dynamic work. Our team supports the Global Amazon Ads Organization during gaps in business coverage due to leaves of absence, roles to be hired, and unexpected employee movement. Amazon Adapt's vision is to provide the world's most customer\-centric business coverage, exceeding both customer and employee expectations during periods of transition.

The ideal candidate is a content creator who understands how to translate books, authors, and cultural moments into engaging, platform\-specific content. This individual will collaborate closely with title marketers, authors, and other internal partners to develop creative social campaigns supporting both frontlist and backlist titles.
  
  

**Primary Responsibilities:**  

* Plan, create, schedule, and monitor content across Scribner’s social media platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, and emerging channels.
* Manage Scribner’s social media content calendar, balancing priority title campaigns, imprint\-wide initiatives, cultural moments, and backlist opportunities.
* Develop and manage Scribner’s influencer outreach efforts, including identifying creators, maintaining relationships, coordinating mailings, and tracking campaign results.
* Collaborate with title marketers to develop creative social media strategies and content for individual book campaigns.
* Track social media performance, analyze engagement data, and share actionable insights to improve content and campaign strategies.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators for social campaigns.
* Stay current on social media trends, platform updates, emerging technologies, and conversations relevant to books and publishing.
* Attend select in\-person and virtual events to capture content for Scribner’s social channels.
* Contribute ideas for growing Scribner’s presence across established platforms and thoughtfully expanding onto new channels.


**Qualifications:**  

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in social media marketing, digital marketing, content creation, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing branded social media accounts and developing platform\-specific content.
* Strong photography, videography, video\-editing, and social\-first copywriting skills.
* Highly creative, with the ability to identify trends and translate them into thoughtful, brand\-appropriate content.
* Experience with organic and paid influencer outreach and an interest in building long\-term creator relationships.
* Familiarity with social media analytics, reporting, and performance measurement.
* Experience with tools such as Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Sprinklr, Canva, or comparable platforms is preferred.
* Excellent organizational and project\-management skills, with the ability to balance multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with authors and colleagues across marketing, publicity, editorial, and design.
* Passion for books, authors, and engaging with the online reading community.

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



DoorDash for Business (DDfB) is one of DoorDash's fastest\-growing businesses, helping organizations engage and support their employees through meal benefits, workplace catering, gifting, and other workplace solutions. As companies invest in employee engagement and return\-to\-office initiatives, we're expanding our product offerings, launching internationally, and building toward a one\-stop solution for corporate workplace needs. Joining this team means joining a startup within DoorDash \- you'll have the ownership and speed of a high\-growth business backed by the scale, resources, and brand of a global leader.


**About the Role**
------------------



We're looking for an Inbound Sales Development Representative to join our DoorDash for Business team, focused on converting inbound interest into qualified pipeline within Mid Market to Strategic accounts. You'll work inbound leads within SLA, quickly assessing fit and intent before they ever reach an Account Executive. As DDfB's first line of communication for prospects who've already raised their hand, you'll shape their first impression of us and run structured discovery conversations that set our sales team up for success. You'll also take on periodic outbound\-oriented projects tied to DoorDash for Business growth and GTM testing, using our existing playbook.



You will report into the Business Development Manager in our pre\-sales organization.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Own inbound leads from the moment they hit your queue, working within defined SLAs to make first contact, qualify, and route \- speed and responsiveness are the job, not a nice\-to\-have
* Qualify inbound interest against clear criteria\- and just as importantly, disqualify quickly and cleanly so sales time goes to the accounts worth pursuing
* Run structured discovery on inbound conversations to understand intent and need, then hand off well\-briefed, sales\-ready meetings to Account Executives
* Take on side projects tied to DDfB growth and GTM testing — new channel experiments, campaign tests, and initiatives that pull on outbound prospecting and multi\-touch outreach skills alongside your core inbound work
* Partner closely with Account Executives and Marketing to close the loop on lead quality, surfacing patterns in what's converting (and what isn't) back to the team
* Participate in ongoing sales training and coaching to develop your skills in qualification, discovery, and objection handling plus occasional outbound fundamentals to support cross\-functional project work and promotion

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have 6 months\+ of experience in B2B sales, SDR/BDR, or a related inbound sales environment
* You have a track record of meeting or exceeding activity, SLA and conversion pipeline goals in a quota\-driven environment
* You can quickly assess fit and intent on a lead — and you're comfortable disqualifying as confidently as you qualify
* You are proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Outreach, and use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to support process, qualification and prospecting
* You're adaptable \- equally comfortable reacting fast to an inbound queue and picking up structured outbound work when a growth or GTM test calls for it
* You have a resilient, gritty mindset and thrive navigating complexity and ambiguity in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment


Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
