### **About TouchCare**



TouchCare is a healthcare concierge and benefits advocacy company making healthcare easier to navigate. For more than a decade, we've helped employees and their families understand and maximize their benefits while helping employers deliver a better healthcare experience.



Now, we're growing—and expanding our Sales team to help bring TouchCare to more employers across the country.


### **The Opportunity**



We're looking for a **Sales Development Representative (BDR)** to join our growing Sales team in **NYC.**



You'll be on the front lines of TouchCare's growth—connecting with brokers and benefits professionals, opening new relationships, and generating opportunities for our Sales team.



This is an opportunity to **learn B2B / B2C sales from experienced leaders, become an expert in the healthcare and benefits industry, and build toward an Account Executive career path.**


### **What You'll Do**


* Identify and connect with brokers, benefits professionals, and prospective partners through **phone, email, LinkedIn, and industry events**.
* Research target accounts and create thoughtful, personalized outreach.
* Qualify inbound and outbound prospects and generate meetings for our Sales team.
* Build and nurture relationships with prospects who may not be ready to buy today.
* Partner closely with Account Executives on messaging, account strategy, and prospecting.
* Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, events, and lead\-generation initiatives.
* Become an expert on TouchCare, our solutions, buyers, and competitive landscape.
* Maintain accurate activity and pipeline information in our CRM.
* Meet and exceed activity, meeting, and pipeline goals.

### **What You'll Bring**


* **2–5 years of sales, business development, or related experience**; B2B experience preferred.
* Strong communication skills and confidence starting conversations with new people.
* A competitive, goal\-oriented mindset and desire to succeed.
* Curiosity, coachability, resilience, and strong follow\-through.
* Ability to research prospects and create personalized outreach.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Healthcare, employee benefits, HR technology, or SaaS experience is a plus.
* Excitement about working **onsite in our Stamford office five days per week**.

### **Why TouchCare?**



TouchCare has **10\+ years of success** behind us and an exciting period of growth ahead.



You'll join a collaborative team, work directly alongside experienced Sales and company leaders, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact on our growth. We see Business Development as a **launching point for future sales talent**, with opportunities for high performers to grow into Account Executive and other sales roles as we scale.



If you're **competitive, curious, coachable, and ready to build your sales career**, we'd love to meet you.


**Compensation:** $60,000–$70,000 base salary, based on experience and qualifications.


**Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, paid time off, parental leave, and other company\-sponsored benefits.


**Location:** NYC \| **Onsite 5 days per week**


*TouchCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any legally protected status.*

jobs.title: REMOTE SALES REPRESENTATIVE (Virtual Healthcare Services)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


CompassionMD™ provides affordable, direct virtual medical care to individuals, families, small businesses, and large organizations nationwide. Our model gives people 24/7 access to board\-certified doctors, virtual urgent care, mental health consultations, medical guidance, and other valuable health services at predictable, transparent pricing.


We are expanding across the United States and are seeking motivated **Sales Representatives** who can introduce our direct virtual care programs to consumers and to organizations of all sizes.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


This is a **sales\-focused**, **remote**, **performance\-based** role suited for someone who:

* Has an existing client base, business network, or broad community influence
* Has experience selling to **individuals**, **small businesses**, or **mid\-to\-large organizations**
* Is comfortable offering a subscription\-based virtual healthcare program
* Wants to build **recurring residual income** through ongoing membership renewals
* Prefers flexible work hours and autonomy


You will present, promote, and help enroll people and organizations into CompassionMD™ virtual health subscription plans.

**What You’ll Sell**
--------------------


Our direct virtual care programs include:

* 24/7 doctor access
* Virtual urgent care
* Medical guidance \& care navigation
* Mental health consultations
* Prescription support
* Hospital bill negotiation services
* Additional associated benefits


Plans are priced to be affordable for individuals, families, and organizations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Sell CompassionMD™ virtual health subscriptions nationwide
* Conduct outreach to individuals, families, and organizations
* Present our services to small and mid\-sized businesses (bulk enrollment options)
* Work with groups, associations, nonprofits, and employers
* Manage your own leads or use your existing network
* Track enrollments and customer follow\-up
* Collaborate with internal support teams for onboarding

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

* Experience in **sales**, **benefits**, **healthcare**, **insurance**, **affiliate marketing**, or **business development**
* Strong existing network or the ability to build one
* Excellent communication skills
* Professional, organized, and self\-motivated
* Comfortable working independently
* Tech\-savvy and confident presenting virtually

*No healthcare license is required.*

**Compensation**
----------------

* **Performance\-based commissions**
* **Monthly residual income** for active subscribers you enroll
* **Unlimited** earning potential tied directly to your production
* All commission structures are fully disclosed during the interview

**Why This Role Appeals to Top Salespeople**
--------------------------------------------

* Work entirely from home
* National market—no territory limitations
* Highly relevant product (healthcare is universally needed)
* Subscription model allows ongoing monthly earnings
* Strong value proposition for individuals AND businesses
* Backed by a national virtual health platform

jobs.title: Confidential Executive Assistant (Legal) - Excluded
jobs.description:
Confidential Executive Assistant (Legal) \- Excluded


**POSITION DETAILS**


The CUNY School of Medicine (CUNY SoM) located in the heart of Harlem, New York, is the only medical school in the City University of New York system and the only public medical school in Manhattan. Building upon 50 years of success as the Sophie Davis School of Biomedical Education, the institution transitioned to the CUNY School of Medicine (SoM) in 2016\. The CUNY SoM offers an accelerated BS/MD degree (7\-year program) and a Physician Assistant Master's Degree (27 months program). True to its legacy of access, opportunity, and community transformation, the medical school's mission remains to recruit highly talented students as diverse as New York City itself. CUNY SoM places a special emphasis on training high quality, culturally competent health professionals and scientists equipped to address the healthcare needs of New York's medically under\-served communities. As a major priority, CUNY SoM also seeks to enhance the recruitment and retention of senior leadership, faculty, and staff to more closely reflect the diversity of our student body.


The Confidential Executive Assistant serves as a key administrative and professional support resource to the Chief Campus Counsel \& Labor Designee and the Office of Legal Counsel. The position operates in a highly confidential and professional environment and supports the effective administration of legal office functions, requiring discretion, initiative, sound judgment, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently with sensitive information and matters involving the SoM.


Reporting directly to the Chief Campus Counsel \& Labor Designee of the Legal department, the Confidential Executive Assistant's duties include but are not limited to the following responsibilities:


* Provides high\-level, confidential administrative, operational, and legal support to the Chief Campus Counsel \& Labor Designee; exercises independent judgment in managing priorities, sensitive matters, deadlines, correspondence, and day\-to\-day operations of the Office of Legal Counsel.
* Manages the complex and frequently changing calendar; schedules and coordinates internal and external meetings, resolves scheduling conflicts, organizes meeting logistics, and communicates competing priorities and potential solutions.
* Assists with the coordination and administration of legal matters, including litigation, arbitrations, hearings, investigations, subpoenas, disciplinary matters, human rights complaints, contracts, affiliation agreements, and other legal proceedings; monitors deadlines, maintains status information, and provides timely updates to legal counsel.
* Conducts research on legal, regulatory, policy, labor, and institutional matters at the direction of the Chief Campus Counsel \& Labor Designee; researches CUNY policies, collective bargaining agreements, statues, regulations, and other authoritative sources and prepares and prepares summaries and reports for attorney review.
* Assists with Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) requests by gathering, reviewing, analyzing, organizing, and maintaining responsive records; identifies records requiring Attorney review for redaction or disclosure and assists in ensuring responses are processed within applicable deadlines and confidentiality requirements.
* Assists with legal matter intake, including initial screening of matters involving discrimination, harassment, sex\-based misconduct, employee and student concerns, and other matters referred to the Office of Legal Counsel; prepares interview and intake summaries and ensures relevant information is accurately documented and communicate to appropriate legal personnel.
* Drafts, proofreads, and finalizes confidential correspondence, memoranda, reports, presentations, agendas, minutes, and other materials; compiles legal and administrative data and prepares periodic statistical and narrative reports.
* Develops and maintains secure electronic and paper filing systems for confidential legal records, including litigation, investigation, contract, subpoena, disciplinary, and other legal matter files; ensures records are accurately organized, securely maintained, and accessible to authorized personnel.
* Serves as a liaison between the Office of Legal Counsel and University administrators, faculty, staff, students, external parties, and other University offices; responds to inquiries, coordinates communications, and exercises discretion when communicating on behalf of the Chief Campus Counsel \& Labor Designee.
* Coordinates legal office operations and projects, including Board meetings, legal team meetings, training and legal programming, distribution lists, expense reports, action\-item tracking, and special projects; coordinates with Attorneys, administrative staff, and other support personnel to ensure assignments and projects are completed accurately and timely.
* Maintains strict confidentiality and security of privileged, sensitive, and legally protected information in accordance with CUNY policies and applicable laws; supports process improvements.
* Performs other related duties and special assignments as assigned by the Chief Campus Counsel \& Labor Designee.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


Bachelor's degree and four years' related experience required.


**Preferred:**


* Experience providing administrative support to an Attorney, General Counsel, or Senior Administrator, preferably in higher education, government, or a public\-sector environment.
* Knowledge of CUNY policies, procedures, collective bargaining agreements, and University operations.
* Experience handling confidential personnel, labor, legal, student, or institutional matters.
* Experience assisting with legal matters such as litigation, investigations, FOIL requests, subpoenas, contracts, hearings, or disciplinary matters.
* Strong research, writing, organizational, and communication skills.

jobs.description:
Position Purpose:  


Night Operations Assistant Store Manager in Training (NOASM\-IT) will gain hands\-on experience in the key responsibilities and functions of a Night Operations Assistant Store Manager at The Home Depot. The OAM \- IT will undergo a comprehensive training program that includes hands\-on experience, mentorship, and leadership development. During their training, NOASMs in Training will become familiar with Manager on Duty duties and will focus on overseeing overnight freight operations to ensure the successful execution of core freight handling programs. They will frequently collaborate with Night Replenishment Managers (NRMs) to manage the unload, pack out, and pack down NOASM’s in Training will collaborate with the Store Manager, Assistant Store Managers (ASMs), and field teams and learn to develop and implement strategies that boost sales and profitability, creating actionable game plans for departmental success, and ensuring smooth department operations. NOASM \- ITs are expected to lead by example. Additionally, they have a responsibility to uphold, maintain, and support all lawful company policies and positions. During the NOASM\-IT training period, which will be up to 6 weeks, you will be learning to execute OASM key responsibilities.  


Key Responsibilities:  


10% \- Customer Experience \- Supervising Associates in the selling effort and lead GET culture and set the example. Drive customer service and associate engagement through the store; ensure Customer concerns are solved effectively and take necessary actions to resolve situations promptly  
15% \- Operations Management \- Perform Opening, Closing MOD and other whole store focus responsibilities. Adhere to all Company policies and procedures and hold associates accountable for following all Company policies and procedures. Command of store standard operating procedures (SOP’s), especially those involving Safety compliance and learn tactics to maintain process accuracy and take steps to mitigate shrink  
15% \- Safety \- Ensure self and associates follow all safety and hazmat procedures and Safety Matters guidelines at all times  
10% \- Sales and Productivity \- Work with key partners to plan merchandise placement, signing and support stock integrity through inventory management. ASMs in Training will learn how to maintain and operate all store equipment and systems as well as how to manage daily financial operations.  
50% \- Training and Preparing for Assistant Manager Position \- Participate in a structured training program covering all aspects of retail store management, including operations, customer service, sales \& profitability, and company policies and procedures. Learn and demonstrate tactics to support key accountability: staffing and scheduling, identifying and resolving stock deficiencies, supervisor associates in selling behaviors, resolving customer issues and concerns, and supporting service needs for both installed sales/special orders and product sales. Learn and demonstrate the performance management process, to include review of associate performance and how to execute the associate disciplinary process when necessary. Complete all assigned training modules and assessments.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food \& beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.  

  

Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  

  

**Job Description:**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

DG360, a service offering supported by Barry\-Wehmiller Design Group, provides operational support, service coordination, preventative maintenance, emergency response, and project execution support for clients with complex, mission\-critical facilities and operational environments. Our team works closely with project managers, technical specialists, field service professionals, subcontractors, and client stakeholders to support efficient project execution, strong communication, and reliable service delivery.


We are focused on providing our professionals with opportunities for leadership and career advancement within a thriving work environment and a unique people\-centric culture.


DG360 is seeking exceptional candidates who thrive in fast\-paced work environments and are capable of supporting active service and project operations through strong organization, communication, follow\-through, and problem\-solving skills. This role will support project coordination, service operations, scheduling activities, documentation management, meeting coordination, reporting, and cross\-functional communication across active client projects and operational programs.


When you join DG360 as a Project Coordinator, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with seasoned leaders, project managers, technical specialists, subject matter experts, field service teams, and senior leadership to provide timely and accurate information associated with active projects and ongoing service operations.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinate updates from key contributors on projects to ensure transparency with leadership regarding risk, schedule, and financial position.
* Support operational leadership by collecting, organizing, and summarizing project and operational updates for review by the senior leadership team.
* Support Project Managers with coordination of active operational and service\-related projects across multiple client accounts.
* Maintain project tracking systems, schedules, operational documentation, and status records to ensure visibility across active initiatives.
* Coordinate communication between project management, engineering teams, field personnel, subcontractors, and client stakeholders.
* Assist with tracking project milestones, action items, operational risks, and scheduling conflicts.
* Attend operational and project\-related meetings to capture notes, document action items, identify responsible parties, and distribute meeting minutes and summary recaps to stakeholders.
* Assist with coordinating project and site readiness activities including documentation collection, scheduling support, access coordination, and required pre\-work information.
* Support process improvement initiatives by helping develop and maintain standardized operational workflows, tracking procedures, and administrative processes.
* Maintain organized network storage folders, project documentation repositories, and shared project resources.
* Review reports, trackers, and project documentation to support accuracy, consistency, and error proofing.
* Identify client or internal inquiries and ensure successful transfer of ownership to the appropriate project, technical, or operational resource.
* Track and facilitate requests between project managers, engineering teams, technical specialists, field personnel, and operational stakeholders to ensure required information is provided in a timely and complete manner.
* Act as the first\-pass resource to help identify and resolve administrative or accounting\-related issues such as past due invoices, invoice discrepancies, purchase requests, labor tracking discrepancies, and documentation inconsistencies.
* Drive project success by collaborating with project management, engineering, procurement, accounting, field teams, and leadership to ensure timely completion of critical tasks.
* Support data entry, recordkeeping, and database updates for information collected from the field or generated through project execution.
* Escalate risks, blockers, or unresolved issues to leadership when additional support or direction is needed.
* Provide general operational and administrative support to project managers, service teams, field personnel, and leadership.
* Support ad\-hoc projects or responsibilities depending on organizational needs.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Detail oriented, highly organized, with strong multi\-tasking and time management skills.
* Take ownership of responsibilities and assigned tasks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Self\-sufficient and self\-motivated.
* Ability to work independent

jobs.title: Community Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**


Person in this position will be responsible for providing support, outreach, and engagement services to veterans and service members at risk of suicide. Utilizing lived experience and trauma\-informed care, the specialist builds trust with participants, connects them to essential services, and promotes hope, recovery, and wellness. Essential functions include those listed below.


**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Conduct community outreach and engagement activities to identify and connect with at\-risk veterans and service members.
* Provide support and mentorship using shared lived experience to foster trust and empowerment.
* Assist individuals in navigating mental health and substance use services, housing resources, crisis intervention, and other support systems.
* Collaborate with local VA facilities, community providers, and the broader support network to coordinate services and referrals.
* Participate in suicide prevention trainings and maintain knowledge of best practices related to veteran care.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of all interactions and services provided, in compliance with grant requirements and confidentiality standards.
* Support follow\-up efforts with program participants to ensure continued engagement and service connection.
* Promote protective factors such as connectedness, resilience, and purpose among participants.
* Attend and participate in team meetings, supervision, and relevant community events.

The Event Coordinator is a key player in the success of these events. You will help build the staffing plan, brief the team, proactively engage staff during the event, handle event\-day operations, and represent S.A.F.E. in front of the client.  


This is a hands\-on operations role for someone who aspires to grow in the sports \& entertainment industry.

* Build and update event\-day documentation, post assignments, and staffing plans

* Solve day\-of problems quickly: call\-offs, gate changes, crowd flow, client requests, weather, unique event operations
* Brief the team prior to the start of the event and assist with debriefing afterward so the next event runs better

  

**Build the Team*** Participate in the recruiting process, including sourcing, applicant tracking, and interview scheduling
* Support critical teammate trainings such as, New Hire, Returning Staff, and Leadership trainings
* Handle staff questions in real time, on and off site
* Set the tone on professionalism and accountability that the team follows

Strong operators are organized operators and this sets the tone for game and event day.* Create and schedule events in our workforce management platform
* Submit and reconcile crew calls accurately in the timekeeping system
* Invoice completed events promptly and accurately
* Respond to office calls and emails within a timely manner
* Maintain clear, organized event documentation so another team member can step in and run the event if needed

* 0 to 5 years of experience out of school
* A track record of competing on a team. Athletics, a campus organization, or an early job where your performance was measured and other people depended on you
* Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environment
* Ability to communicate in front of a crowd and to senior\-level leadership
* Detail oriented, proficient with Microsoft Office, and the ability to quickly to pick up new systems

The **Field Operations Specialist (FOS)** is a field role that ensures Progress homes are secure and in a marketable leasing condition. This role requires basic maintenance and repair skills, such as the ability to change smoke detector batteries, light bulbs and filters or winterization of homes.

* Posts notices on home and communicates status with photos to applicable team members.
* Appears at eviction lockouts, as needed.
* Follows Fleet vehicle maintenance schedule, keep an organized and clean vehicle/workspace , and manage Fleet inventory within company guidelines.
* May also be responsible for administrative functions in customer service.

company and client objectives.

* Conduct all business in accordance with the Associa Chicagoland and the Association's policies and procedures, fair housing, Americans with Disabilities Act, and all other laws pertaining to condominiums.

* Respond to emergencies as needed.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of all unit owner, resident, employee, entity owner, and property information.

**About Us:** Volunteers of America is a national, faith\-based nonprofit founded over 125 years ago. VOA Illinois delivers strength\-based, trauma\-informed, and culturally sensitive programs across the state. We are a certified Great Place to Work and proudly promote from within — over 50% of our workforce has advanced into new roles within the organization. **Program Overview:** The North Lawndale College Prep initiative supports youth, families, and educators through trauma\-informed programming designed to address the impact of community violence and strengthen school culture. jobs.title: Volunteer, Foster and Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Title: Volunteer, Foster and Program Coordinator


Location: Naperville, Illinois


Department: Shelter


Reports To: Executive Director


FLSA Status: Full Time/Part\-time, Non\-exempt


Pay Range: $17\.00\-$19\.00 DOE


About Us:


A.D.O.P.T. is a private, non\-profit 501(c)(3\) organization that has found homes for more than 30,000 pets. We provide a temporary, loving home for dogs and cats that no longer have a family of their own. The animals in our shelter have ended up here for a variety of reasons ranging from abandonment, to rescue from an abusive situation, to owner surrender because they no longer are able to take care of them. Our animals are loving, family pets who are desperately awaiting for their forever home.


A.D.O.P.T. was founded in 1989 by a group of dedicated volunteers determined to find homes for animals in need. Over the years, our objective has remained the same: to place animals into permanent, caring homes and advance the humane treatment of animals through education.


Job Purpose:


The Volunteer, Foster and Program Coordinator shall be responsible for the coordination, orientation and scheduling of all A.D.O.P.T. volunteers for shelter support, clinic assistance, programming and fundraising events. This role will also plan, coordinate and participate in the activities of any after\-school or weekend programs and summer day camps of A.D.O.P.T. The position will require collaborative efforts with parents and staff. This role is key in providing education for youth, groups and overall community.


Duties \& Responsibilities:

* Training, scheduling, and supervising of front desk, animal care and administrative volunteers.
* Recruiting of new volunteers
* Management of record keeping for volunteers through Volgistics
* Scheduling and presentation of volunteer orientation to be held monthly
* Assisting with events and activities as needed
* Meeting and greeting visitors to the shelter
* Management of community service volunteer program
* Coordinates volunteer recognition programs
* Management of corporate volunteer groups
* Conducts informational sessions for potential volunteers and speaks with various groups regarding volunteer opportunities, animal adoption and rescue awareness
* Handling and addressing conflicts that arise within volunteer groups.
* Work with the Executive Director, Shelter Operations Manager and Animal Program Instructor on developing and directing youth outreach programming for K through 12th grade, including but not limited to youth programs, special events centered around animal welfare and humane education.
* Coordinate and manage schedules and activities of programs and summer day camps.
* Provide supervision for after\-school programs and summer day camps. This would also require coordinating staffing necessary for programs.
* Coordinate and manage all summer camp applications for families and the community.
* Maintain detailed enrollment records for all programming, including after\-school program and summer day camps.
* Responsible for recording and processing information relative to statistics, finances, communications, and evaluation for all programming.
* Create weekly and monthly program schedules for all programs, including detailed after\-school programs and summer day camp schedules.
* Troubleshoot logistics of our animals’ arrival and finding available foster homes.
* Provide foster families with everything they’ll need, like:
* Information and advice on caring for animals using fear\-free methods, common animal medical concerns to be aware of, reading animal behavior, etc.
* Loading them up with the basics: food, litter, bedding, toys, and more.
* Making the introduction to their new furry foster!
* Respond to foster families’ questions and concerns with urgency.
* Work collaboratively with other departments to triage any medical and/or behavioral concerns of foster animals. Attend events to promote our foster program and recruit more foster families.
* Help organize foster\-based adoption events to find our animals forever families!
* Ensure all material used in any programming aligns with A.D.O.P.T’s mission and vision statements.
* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in a manner that fosters and maintains positive relationships with co\-workers and supervisors. This would include but not be limited to such actions:
* resolution of conflicts in a positive manner;
* courteous treatment of staff, clients, and visitors;
* respect of others' property and person;
* professional and appropriate communication to and about co\-workers, supervisors, and subordinates.
* Support the Mission of A.D.O.P.T. by treating every donor, contact and colleague with respect and dignity, and without discrimination of any kind.
* Additional duties as assigned
* Duties and responsibilities may change, and new ones may be added, at any time with or without advanced notice.


Skills \& Qualifications

* A.D.O.P.T. functions seven days per week, evening or weekend hours will be necessary on occasion
* Ability to work as a team player with other staff and volunteers
* A positive attitude and the ability to be flexible changing job positions/priorities.
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Uses diplomacy and good judgment.
* Demonstrated ability to use initiative and be a self\-starter.
* Attention to detail, procedures, processes, and policies.
* Possess a basic knowledge of dog/cat breed characteristics and behaviors
* Possess safe animal handling skills and be comfortable interacting with all varieties and temperaments of dogs and cats while maintaining a safe, calm, and humane work environment
* Experience training and supervising volunteers
* Customer service experience preferred
* College or advanced degree preferred
* Experience with animal foster programs

**Company Description**  

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

The **Operations Coordinator Nurse**reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

  

Under the clinical direction of the Medical Director and the administrative direction of the Practice Manager, the Operations Coordinator, Nurse participates in the planning, leading, and organizing of activities relating to quality patient care in the practice. S/he supervises and personally provides nursing care in the practice.

  

The Operations Coordinator Nurse will be responsible for supervising the daily operations of practice site(s), supervising clinical and administrative support personnel, coordinating provider schedules, manage practice collections, ensure service excellence and perform service recovery as necessary.

  

Position manages workload distribution and prioritization of tasks. Responsible for front\-line communication with staff to receive and provide feedback regarding quality and productivity. Position may perform staff work in assigned areas of responsibility when not conducting coordinator function.

* Supervise and direct the office’s front\-line clinical and clerical staff.
* Participate in interviewing, hiring, training, progressive discipline, dismissals, and performance appraisals.
* Oversee and direct day to day office operations within budget guidelines.
* Assist with managing providers’ schedules with templates and optimize patient care hours to enhance productivity.
* Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, and staff productivity.
* Conduct timely and accurate cash management duties, including overseeing the collection of co\-pays and patient balances, in\-house cash balances, and bank deposits.
* Ensure that service excellence is delivered and perform service recovery whenever necessary.
* Manage office and medical surgical supplies within budget
* Ensure accuracy of all data collection and data entry by site staff through training and compliance monitoring and facilitate and oversee flow of information to and from central administrative offices.
* Conduct office staff meetings on a regular basis.
* Attend and actively participate in manager/supervisor meetings.
* Ensure that patient dignity and confidentiality are maintained at all times.
* Additional Functions
	+ Review and approve automated time reports for accuracy.
	+ Develop tools to support staff and enhance efficiency.
	+ Provide input into staff performance reviews. May participate with manager in conducting staff performance reviews. Provide one to one coaching and mentoring.
	+ Plan, execute and resolve all routine technical needs of the practice (phone, copiers, fax machines, PCs, etc)
	+ Monitor daily transaction activity to ensure compliance with procedures.
	+ Resolve complex or critical situations involving patients, staff and customers: consults with manager for guidance as needed (e.g., complaints, discipline, etc.).
	+ Schedule staff and allocate resources across hours of operation to maximize patient access and satisfaction, provider productivity and efficiency, staff productivity, cost\-savings, and operational efficiencies.
	+ Develop and implement policies and procedures as needed to support the practice.
	+ Complete other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications** **Required**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience
* Minimum of three years work experience in a medical or related business
* Comprehension of insurance plans including HMO,PPO, POS, commercial, Medicare, Medicaid
* Solid understanding of patient flow in a medical office
* Leadership experience
* Working knowledge of medical software, Word and Excel
* Experience managing daily cash activity and reconciling income reports with daily payments.
* Current License as Registered Professional Nurse in state employed in.
* CPR

  

**Preferred:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Knowledge of coding
* Supervisory experience

jobs.title: Post-Sales Operations & Implementation Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Post\-Sales Operations \& Implementation Coordinator**

  

**Join the UNDISPUTED \#1 Best Place to Work in Chicago 4 years in a row!**

**Green Office Partner**  

**Full\-time**  

**In\-Office \| Chicago, IL, United States**

**Post Name:** Post\-Sales Operations \& Implementation Coordinator, also known as Order\-to\-Install (OTI Coordinator)

**Position Overview:**


Green Office Partner, ranked the **\#1** Best Place to Work by Crain’s (2023,24,25 \& 26\) and the Chicago Sun\-Times (2024 \& 2025\), is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Post\-Sales Operations \& Implementation Coordinator (OTI Coordinator**) to manage the critical transition from a signed customer agreement through installation readiness and final project closeout.


We deliver HP and Xerox Managed Print Services, Intelligent Document Processing, and Conference Room/Audio\-Video Solutions that help enterprises reduce costs, increase efficiency, and modernize their workplaces.


The **OTI Coordinator** serves as the operational connection between **Sales, Purchasing, Finance, Project Management, and Client Success**, ensuring every new customer order is accurate, properly staged, internally aligned, and ready for successful implementation.


This role owns the post\-signature coordination process—including order verification, system setup, internal kickoff meetings, client onboarding coordination, milestone tracking, and final Delivery \& Acceptance documentation.


The ideal candidate enjoys bringing structure to complex processes, coordinating multiple departments, communicating directly with clients, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Order Staging:** Review signed agreements for accurate equipment, leasing, billing, and customer information.
* **System Setup:** Coordinate post\-sale customer setup and updates across CRM, ERP, and monitoring systems.
* **Internal Coordination:** Lead the internal handoff meeting with Project Management, Purchasing, Finance, and Client Success.
* **Client Onboarding:** Co\-lead the customer kickoff, confirm scope and site requirements, and transition installation to the Project Manager.
* **Project Tracking:** Monitor key milestones and help resolve outstanding operational items throughout implementation.
* **Project Closeout:** Secure signed Delivery \& Acceptance (D\&A) documentation and submit completed packages to Finance.
* **Lease Returns:** Coordinate final payments, LOIs, timing, and documentation for equipment returns when applicable.

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in **order management, sales operations, project coordination, customer onboarding, or a similar operational role**.
* Experience working with CRM, ERP, order\-management, or related business systems.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple customer projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong cross\-functional communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively between Sales, Finance, Operations, Purchasing, and Project Management.
* Professional client\-facing communication skills and confidence participating in customer onboarding meetings.
* Ability to identify missing information, resolve operational issues, and proactively move projects forward.
* Comfortable working in a process\-driven environment where documentation accuracy and timely follow\-through are critical.

**What Success Looks Like**


Success in this role means that when a customer signs an agreement, the transition into implementation feels **organized, professional, and seamless**.


Orders are accurate. Internal teams know their responsibilities. Customers understand what happens next. Project Managers receive complete information. Installations move forward without avoidable delays. And final documentation is completed quickly so the project can be properly closed and funded.


The **OTI Coordinator** is the person who **connects all of those pieces together.**

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Performance\-based compensation opportunities where applicable.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and wellness benefits.
* 401(k) retirement savings program with competitive employer matching.
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and company\-paid holidays.
* Company\-supported professional development and training opportunities.
* Collaborative work environment with direct exposure to Sales, Operations, Finance, Project Management, and Client Success leadership.
* Company\-provided technology and tools necessary to effectively manage customer implementations.

**Why Green Office Partner**


At Green Office Partner, we believe great customer experiences are created by great teams working together. The **OTI Coordinator** plays a central role in that experience—connecting the promise made during the sales process with the operational execution that follows.


If you enjoy **organization, accountability, customer interaction, process improvement, and bringing multiple departments together to get things done**, this position provides an opportunity to have a direct impact on both our clients and our organization.

*Green Office Partner is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator - Waldorf Astoria Chicago
jobs.description:
Waldorf Astoria Chicago is looking for a Sales Coordinator to join the team in Chicago's Gold Coast!  

Recognized as one of the Best Hotels in the World and in Chicago with the Top Hotel Spa in the U.S., the AAA\-Five\-Diamond, Forbes 4\-Star Waldorf Astoria Chicago is nestled in the prestigious Gold Coast neighborhood among the famed Oak Street retailers and beach, Rush Street restaurants and nightlife, and The Magnificent Mile. Reminiscent of the grand Parisian hotels of the 1920s, this luxury hotel features 215 rooms, over 5,000 square feet of meeting space and 4 food and beverage outlets. This includes a restaurant, 2 bars, and in\-room dining.  

At Waldorf Astoria, we create unforgettable experiences for our guests, meaningful opportunities for our Team Members, and a positive impact in our community.  

**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a **Sales Coordinator** , you’re not just supporting sales operations and lead generation to help drive new business – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.


  
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:


* **Perform daily sales operations:** Provide administrative support including data entry, invoice distribution, Salesforce activity tracking, and recordkeeping to ensure efficient team operations
* **Support sales documentation and reporting:** Assist with preparing contracts, proposals, RFP responses, client call summaries, and booking and loyalty reports
* **Generate and qualify new business leads:** Research, identify, and evaluate unmanaged and prospect accounts to build and maintain a qualified pipeline

* **Assist with special projects and events:** Support departmental initiatives, customer engagement activities, and participation in meetings and conferences as needed

  
**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:


A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.


  
**How We'll Help You Thrive**

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:


* **Incredible travel perks** – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
* **Paid parental leave** – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
* **Personalized caregiving support** – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
* **Crisis concierge** – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
* **Mental health resources** – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best\-in\-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* **Generous paid time off (PTO)** – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
* **Health \& welfare benefits** – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
* **Financial security for your future** – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next

*\*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.*


  
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**  

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator – Youth Sports
jobs.description:
**Event Operations Supervisor – Youth Sports**

Help create unforgettable experiences for young athletes

We are looking for an organized, energetic Event Operations Coordinator to help bring hundreds of youth sports events to life each year.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys turning plans into great experiences. You will help prepare events, coordinate equipment and materials, work with facilities and vendors, support staff and coaches, and solve the real\-time details that keep an event running smoothly. Some weeks will be carefully planned; others will ask you to adjust quickly. In both cases, your work will matter to the athletes, families, coaches, and teammates counting on us.

You do not need to arrive knowing every part of our operation. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, cares about the details, and is excited to learn how excellent events come together.

What you’ll do

* Coordinate the operational details that help youth sports camps and special events run successfully.
* Prepare event plans, checklists, timelines, materials, equipment, and shipments.
* Track event readiness and follow key details through completion so teams know what is ready and what still needs attention.
* Coordinate with facilities, vendors, coaches, event staff, and internal teams before and during events.
* Help manage inventory, organize event supplies, and make sure materials reach the right event at the right time.
* Support travel, lodging, arrival schedules, parking, certificates of insurance, payments, and other event needs as assigned.
* Provide clear, timely updates when plans change or a teammate needs help.
* Help guide interns and seasonal team members during busy preparation periods.
* Respond to occasional event questions during evenings or weekends in peak season.
* Improve checklists, processes, and shared information so each event becomes easier to prepare and execute.
* Pitch in wherever needed. Our best event operators care more about helping the team succeed than about whose task something is.

You may be a great fit if you

* Enjoy coordinating many moving pieces and bringing order to a busy environment.
* Follow through reliably and take pride in getting the details right.
* Communicate with warmth, clarity, and good judgment.
* Can adjust priorities when new information arrives without losing sight of the larger goal.
* Are comfortable working independently while also knowing when to ask for help.
* Like practical, hands\-on work and are willing to help prepare, organize, receive, and move event materials.
* Work well with different personalities, including coaches, vendors, interns, and teammates.
* Are comfortable learning tools such as Trello, spreadsheets, and event\-management systems.
* Care about youth sports and the opportunity to create meaningful experiences for student\-athletes.

Experience in event operations, sports management, hospitality, travel coordination, facilities, inventory, or a similarly detail\-oriented role is helpful—but we also welcome applicants whose skills come from another setting. If this work sounds energizing and you believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply even if you do not check every box.

What success looks like

In your first few months, you will learn our event calendar, systems, and standards; become a trusted owner of assigned event\-readiness work; help seasonal staff stay organized; and give the team confidence that important details will be carried through to completion.

Over time, you will take greater ownership of events and operational categories, anticipate needs before they become urgent, and help build better ways of working across the Event Operations team.

What you can expect from us

* Purpose\-driven work that directly supports young athletes and their families.
* A collaborative team that values initiative, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
* Real responsibility and the opportunity to grow within a large, national youth sports operation.
* Variety: every event cycle brings new people, locations, and challenges.
* Health insurance and a retirement plan with employer contribution.

Schedule and physical requirements

This position is based in Chicago and generally works from the office 3–4 days per week, with additional in\-person availability during peak event\-preparation and shipping periods. Because our events often occur on weekends, occasional evening or weekend responsiveness is part of the role.

The position also includes hands\-on work with event supplies and equipment, including receiving, organizing, packing, and moving materials. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals.

About Us

We empower youth athletes through sports, leadership, and personal\-development experiences. Each year, we work with thousands of athletes, families, coaches, facilities, and partners across the country. Behind every successful event is a team that plans carefully, communicates clearly, and cares deeply about the experience we create.

If you want your work to be active, meaningful, and connected to a mission—and you enjoy being the person who helps make everything come together—we would love to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

**Location:** Chicago, Illinois (hybrid; typically 3–4 days per week in office)  
**Job type:** Full\-time

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $62,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Live4Lali is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate by race, age, sex, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, sexual orientation, or disability in its procedures and policies. Involvement in the criminal justice system is not an automatic disqualifier. Live4Lali does not discriminate on the basis of any protected status, complies with the Illinois Human Rights Act, and provides reasonable accommodations as required by law.*

Substance use disorder continues to be a devastating public health crisis. Americans die from drug overdoses at a rate of roughly 210 to 300 people per day. In 2023, there were 105,007 total drug overdose deaths in the United States. In Illinois, 3052 residents died from an accidental drug overdose in 2023, which is more than twice the number of fatal motor vehicle accidents and more than twice the number of homicides. The increase in the number of fatalities is attributed to the rise of synth3etic opioids, such as fentanyl. Since 2013, synthetic opioid deaths in Illinois have increased 3,341%.

Live4Lali has been serving suburban Chicagoland for nearly sixteen years providing critical prevention, education, treatment access, support programs, community solutions\-building initiatives, risk reduction, and overdose prevention services to decrease the devastating toll of the opioid epidemic. mission is to reduce stigma and prevent substance use disorder among individuals, families, and communities, and minimize the overall health, legal and social harms associated with substance use.

This role focuses on community\-based outreach to provide education on risk reduction strategies, naloxone, and overdose prevention, while building trusting relationships with people who use substances. The Outreach Coordinator also provides peer\-based support, drawing on lived experience to reduce harms associated with substance use and connect individuals to resources and support.

Core Responsibilities

* Identify areas of greatest need across Kane/Dupage Counties on the street and within existing services (such as our Mobile Outreach Program) to connect with participants and distribute risk reduction supplies
* Provide peer\-based support to participants through rapport building, recovery coaching, risk reduction–informed interventions, and referrals, using lived experience to support participant\-defined goals and reduce harms associated with substance use.
* Assist with stocking, maintaining, and delivering risk reduction inventory
* Accurately log and report data collected during outreach.
* Provide on the spot training and education in risk reduction, overdose response, and distribute naloxone, the opioid overdose reversal medication across the county
* Identify and collaborate with a range of organizations and entities including but not limited to treatment providers, housing providers, social service organizations, healthcare providers, businesses, government agencies, etc to scale up access to naloxone
* Develop and implement substance use prevention programs targeted at the community
* Develop and deliver professional education and trainings for community members, professionals, students, and the general public on overdose recognition and response, naloxone administration, substance use, and risk reduction practices
* Identify, build, and maintain relationships with community resources—including treatment providers, housing programs, social services, food access programs, and other supports—to develop partnerships and serve as referral and warm handoff resources for participants with identified needs
* Identify and develop safety plans with participants who are at increased risk of overdose
* Assess community needs in collaboration with participants and report to Program Manager to help develop appropriate programs
* Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance at all times
* Identify and maintain appropriate communication with team regarding issues, observations, and opportunities
* Perform other duties as assigned

Desired Qualifications

The Kane/Dupage Counties Outreach Coordinator must be a person of lived experience preferably with at least 2 years in recovery/remission from substance use disorder. Being bilingual in Spanish is a plus. They will preferably also have a minimum of two years’ relevant work experience in substance use disorder, mental health, public health or social work. This candidate will demonstrate the following qualifications:

* Direct service delivery experience in the community social services sector with a demonstrated working knowledge of community\-based programs and community support systems;
* Demonstrated ability to establish rapport with a diverse range of clientele including individuals who are actively using substances and living with significant health challenges;
* Proficiency in technology, including but not limited to Google Drive, Zoom, Microsoft Office Suite and GoToMeeting;
* Demonstrated attention to detail and strong organizational skills;
* Demonstrated knowledge in the areas of safer drug use, addictions, safer sex, sex work, HIV/AIDS, hepatitis C, mental health, etc.;
* Demonstrated knowledge of social justice, health promotion and public health approaches and models of social support and healt

jobs.description:
Your Job
Molex is seeking a Materials and Logistics Coordinator to support Prototype/Proof of Concept (POC) operations. In this role, you will coordinate purchasing, inbound and outbound logistics , material receiving, inventory control, and project kitting. You will help ensure materials are purchased , received, tracked, organized, and delivered efficiently while maintaining accurate system transactions and documentation.


What You Will Do

* Track inbound shipments from international vendors, address customs clearance issues, and coordinate with the shipping dock to support timely material receipt .
* Partner with the Molex Customs Compliance team to build and maintain customs data for parts used in the POC lab.
* Coordinate international shipments, invoicing, crating, packing, and required documentation for POC projects.
* Purchase lab supplies, equipment, packaging, and select off\-the\-shelf project materials through approved purchasing channels, including Coupa punchout catalogs.
* Monitor purchase orders from vendor shipment through goods receipt, resolve price, quantity, or receipt discrepancies, and partner with Accounts Payable as needed to complete PO closeout.
* Receive incoming materials and verify shipments against purchase orders.
* Maintain accurate stockroom organization, inventory records, cycle counts, adjustments, labeling, and lot creation.
* Kit materials for projects, return unused materials to stock, and complete all required system transactions.


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

* Previous experience working in a stockroom, warehouse, materials, or inventory environment.
* Ability to safely lift and move materials weighing up to 35 pounds.

* Experience using an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system; SAP experience is a plus.

What's the role?:

We are seeking a strategic, consultative Partner Account Manager who will drive revenue growth through a key global hyperscale cloud partnership while supporting Enterprise Sales opportunities across APAC.  

This role is not a traditional alliance, channel, or partner marketing position. The successful candidate will act as a strategic sales partner, helping Account Executives identify, shape, accelerate, and close complex enterprise opportunities through strategic cloud partner engagement. They will also be a direct seller, hunting for new business opportunities across the APAC region.### **What You Will Do**

* Partner with Enterprise Account Executives to influence and accelerate strategic opportunities through our cloud ecosystem partnerships.
* Leverage cloud marketplace programs, co\-sell motions, and partner funding initiatives to increase deal size and shorten sales cycles.
* Build and maintain relationships with partner field organizations across the region.
* Prospect and develop new business opportunities within strategic partner accounts.
* Expand existing partner\-related business by identifying new use cases, stakeholders, and revenue opportunities.
* Support partnership KPIs that unlock strategic sales, marketing, and business development investments.

Trackunit is a fast\-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Trackunit specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all. This lack of digitalization has left construction far behind a global economy on the rise and placed the industry as one of the least productive industries too.

**We are looking for...** an **Account Manager** to own and grow Trackunit's commercial relationships across the Lower Mid Market segment of our AME region. You'll be the trusted point of contact for a portfolio of around 60–80 accounts, focused on retention, renewal, and expansion — partnering closely with your CSM counterpart and the wider Commercial team.


With locations in the hearts of London, ON and Chicago, IL we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations or remotely from anywhere in North America. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------

* A place in an **agile growth SaaS business**, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.
* International environment with regular check\-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.
* We take your **personal and professional development** goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.
* **Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché** **to us** or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.
* **Turning the Tide.** At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring \- we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE\&I initiatives here.

**Who are you ideally?**
------------------------

* Experience in a customer\-facing commercial role such as account management, sales, or customer success.
* A proven track record of managing renewals and growing revenue within an existing account base.
* Strong CRM discipline — you keep opportunity data accurate and up to date.
* Comfortable working independently and owning outcomes across a portfolio of accounts.
* Able to partner effectively across teams — CSM, RAB, Marketing and Technical Support.

  

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries \- this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* Own and grow Annual Recurring Revenue within your Lower Mid Market account portfolio.
* Identify and mitigate churn risk across your accounts.
* Maintain CRM health across all opportunities.
* Partner with your Customer Success Manager counterpart to deliver continued account health.
* Deliver regular QBRs and drive strategic Trackunit product initiatives within your segment.

**Our hiring process**
----------------------


Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

* Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.
* A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.
* If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.
* Offer presentation and walk\-through. We’re lucky to have you!

**The question is: Are you in?**

 *Trackunit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex* *(including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.*

jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
Carrier Sales Representative

**Roots Logistics \| Chicago, IL**  
**Full\-Time \| Monday through Friday (Days Vary)**

In This Role as a National Account Manager you will work alongside an experienced Carrier Sales team responsible for securing reliable transportation capacity, negotiating rates, building carrier relationships, and supporting the successful movement of customer freight throughout North America.

This is a hands\-on role that requires strong communication, urgency, organization, negotiation skills, and the ability to manage multiple shipments and carrier relationships at the same time. You will be expected to perform the full responsibilities of a National Account Manager while also placing a strong emphasis on identifying, developing, and maintaining new carrier relationships.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working within a close\-knit team environment while taking personal ownership of growing their carrier network. Success in this role requires someone who can service today’s freight while continuously building the carrier relationships Roots Logistics will need tomorrow.

We are looking for someone who views every carrier conversation as an opportunity to build trust, strengthen our network, and create a long\-term partnership.

**Working for Roots Logistics**

At other large companies, employees can easily get lost among numerous departments and layers of management. That is not the case at Roots Logistics.

Although we manage a large and complex transportation operation, we maintain a collaborative team structure that allows employees to communicate seamlessly across departments and locations. Regardless of your job title, you will play an important role in helping the company move forward, meet customer expectations, and continuously improve its operations.

Our National Account Managers work closely together, sharing information, supporting one another, and helping the team secure the best possible transportation solutions for our customers. This is an environment where teamwork matters, individual effort is recognized, and your ability to build strong carrier relationships can directly contribute to the company’s growth.

**About Roots Logistics**

Roots Logistics is a growing transportation and freight brokerage company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. We provide dependable transportation solutions throughout North America by combining an experienced operations team, an extensive carrier network, industry\-leading technology, and around\-the\-clock support.

Our operation is supported by team members in Chicago, Miami, Tampa, Colombia, Serbia, and the Philippines. This structure allows us to provide continuous coverage and responsive service to our customers and carrier partners.

Our vision is to be a progressive company within the complex logistics industry by providing reliable, solutions\-driven service that exceeds our customers’ expectations. We are committed to building long\-term partnerships while creating an environment where employees can develop professionally, expand their skills, and advance their careers.

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Work alongside other National Account Managers in a highly collaborative and team\-oriented environment.
* Secure qualified carrier capacity for customer shipments throughout North America.
* Communicate with carriers, dispatchers, drivers, owner\-operators, and fleet managers regarding available freight and equipment.
* Negotiate competitive and sustainable transportation rates.
* Match available carrier capacity with customer freight based on location, equipment type, timing, service requirements, and pricing.
* Prospect for and develop relationships with new carriers.
* Build a personal network of dependable carrier partners that can support recurring and future freight opportunities.
* Maintain and strengthen relationships with existing carriers.
* Conduct regular outbound calls to identify available equipment and new transportation partners.
* Use load boards, referrals, internal systems, industry contacts, and outbound prospecting to source carrier capacity.
* Present available freight clearly and professionally to prospective carrier partners.
* Understand carrier needs, preferred lanes, equipment availability, and operational capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to convert transactional carrier relationships into consistent, long\-term partnerships.
* Assist with carrier onboarding and ensure all required information and documentation are completed.
* Confirm that carriers meet company, customer, insurance, safety, and compliance requirements before being assigned freight.
* Work closely with Operations, Tracking, Customer Sales, and other internal teams to support successful load execution.
* Communicate shipment requirements, appointment information, routing instructions, and customer expectations accurately.
* Confirm carrier acceptance and verify that all load details are clearly understood.
* Monitor assigned shipments and remain engaged throughout the transportation process.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
About Us: Paychex is reimagining how businesses manage their workforce by bringing payroll, HR, benefits, and advisory services together into a single connected HCM platform. As Paychex and Paycor come together, we're combining innovative technology, data\-driven insights, AI, and human expertise to help organizations work smarter, support their people, and achieve better business outcomes. This is an exciting time to join our team as we continue to invest in innovation, simplify client experiences, and shape the future of work. At Paychex, you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, make a meaningful impact, and be part of something bigger as One Paychex. Overview:

We're looking for a data\-driven Paid Media \& Analytics Specialist to own the day\-to\-day management of our paid advertising program in partnership with our media agency. This person will be the internal point person for a $10M\+ annual paid media investment spanning Google, Meta, LinkedIn, StackAdapt, and other platforms — holding the agency accountable for performance, building the reporting that shows what's working, and translating data into recommendations that lower our cost to acquire a customer. This is an individual contributor role reporting directly into marketing leadership, ideal for someone who is as comfortable in a spreadsheet or dashboard as they are on a call pushing an agency for a clearer answer.


Responsibilities:
* Serve as the primary internal owner of the agency relationship — briefing, reviewing plans, and holding the team accountable for performance across paid search, paid social, and programmatic/display (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, StackAdapt/CM360, and emerging channels).
* Manage and help optimize a $10M\+ annual paid media budget in collaboration with the agency, ensuring efficient pacing, channel mix, and return on ad spend.
* Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting (HubSpot, GA4, platform\-native tools) that track CAC, channel efficiency, funnel conversion, and budget pacing against goal.
* Dig into campaign\- and channel\-level data to spot optimization opportunities and risks — creative fatigue, measurement inflation, broken tracking or conversion feeds, budget concentration — and turn findings into clear recommendations.
* Partner with the agency on quarterly and annual planning, audits, and new\-channel tests, and help stand up measurement as our CDP and media mix model (Google Meridian) come online.
* Stay current on platform updates, betas, and best practices across all managed channels, bringing forward opportunities to test and scale.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with sales, product marketing, and marketing operations to keep paid media strategy aligned with company\-wide CAC reduction and growth targets.
* Maintain data integrity across ad platforms, CRM, and reporting tools, flagging and resolving tracking or attribution gaps.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing or another relatable field \- Preferred
* 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in paid media / digital advertising, in\-house or agency\-side, with direct platform experience across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager; programmatic/DSP experience (StackAdapt or similar) strongly preferred.
* Strong data analysis skills: advanced Excel/Google Sheets required; experience building or maintaining dashboards (HubSpot, GA4, Looker, Tableau, or similar) required; SQL a plus.
* Experience managing or directly contributing to paid media budgets of $5M\+ annually.
* Track record of managing external agency or vendor relationships and holding them accountable to KPIs.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted analytics or reporting tools used to improve marketing productivity.
* Working knowledge of B2B or SMB SaaS acquisition funnels and core metrics (CAC, LTV, conversion rate, ROAS).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to translate data into a clear point of view for non\-analytics stakeholders.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment with shifting priorities.
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, analytics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


Live the Paychex Values:
* Act with uncompromising integrity.


* Provide outstanding service and build trusted relationships.


* Drive innovation in our products and services and continually improve our processes.


* Work in partnership and support each other.


* Be personally accountable and deliver on commitments.


* Treat each other with respect and dignity.


What's in it for you?:
* We value your well\-being: We provide over 21 comprehensive rewards, including medical coverage, virtual wellness classes, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) \+ employer match, adoption assistance, financial assistance, and much more.
* We value your time: From paid time off to company holidays, culture days, and comprehensive work\-life balance programs, we will ensure you have the flexibility you need to be your best.
* We value your development: Our award\-winning training and development programs empower our employees with ongoing learning opportunities to give you the building blocks to grow your career.
* We value your perspective: Our company culture reflects the diversity of our employees. We want you to be you and your voice to be heard.
* We value our communities: We offer paid time off for volunteerism and promote many company\-wide and local initiatives that benefit organizations you care about.
  

Note: The benefits described apply to full\-time employees. Benefits for part\-time, contract, and intern roles may vary.  

Not sure if you meet every requirement?: At Paychex, we know that great talent comes in many forms. If you're passionate about the role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the right fit \- either for this position or another opportunity

* Design and implement targeted InMail and email sequences.

* Book meetings through persuasive outreach and discovery.
* Research prospects to tailor communications effectively.
* Develop engaging messaging to boost campaign responses and generate SQLs.

* Utilize lead\-gen tools, social media, and databases to build pipeline.

* Thrive in dynamic, high\-activity settings; handle rejection gracefully.

* Hustle, resilience, and drive to succeed.
